title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Cloudera Data Platform
description:
**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**DATA PLATFORM TECHNOLOGY / JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Senior Cloudera Data Platform, NiFi & Airflow Administrator**

**Senior / Expert Level | Enterprise Data Platform Operations**

**Short Overview**
  
The Senior Cloudera, NiFi & Airflow Administrator is responsible for the administration, design, operation, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise data platform services. The role provides end-to-end administration of Cloudera Data Platform environments, Apache NiFi data-flow services, and Apache Airflow orchestration services across production and non-production environments. The administrator is expert for distributed data processing, data engines, data ingestion, workflow orchestration, platform automation, observability, troubleshooting, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and operational governance in a mission-critical enterprise environment. The role also requires strong Linux administration skills, including system configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, networking, storage management, and security.

**Overall Experience: 5+ years, senior / expert level**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operate and maintain enterprise data platforms**

Ensure secure, reliable, and stable operation, availability, performance, and resilience of Cloudera, Apache NiFi, and Apache Airflow services across production and non-production environments, including platform security, access control, authentication, authorization, encryption, and compliance with enterprise security standards.

**Design and evolve platform architecture**

Define and review high-availability concepts, disaster recovery arrangements, environment topology, service placement, integration patterns, configuration standards, naming conventions, and operational guidelines.

**Provide senior-level troubleshooting and incident support**

Analyze and resolve complex issues across distributed services, workloads, data flows, workflows, metadata, security, networking, operating systems, storage, databases, JVMs, and dependent infrastructure.

**Support application, analytics, data engineering and data science teams**

Consult teams on solution onboarding, workload design, resource utilization, scheduling, data movement, dependency management, resilience and error handling, operational readiness, and production support requirements.

**Manage platform configuration, security, and access control**

Maintain authentication, authorization, roles, policies, service accounts, certificates, TLS, secrets, network connectivity, encryption settings, and integrations with enterprise identity and security services.

**Perform capacity planning and performance optimization**

Monitor workload concurrency, queues, memory, CPU, storage, network throughput, JVM behavior, NiFi back pressure, repository usage, Airflow scheduler performance, task throughput, metadata database health, and service saturation; recommend scaling and tuning actions.

**Support and maintain non-production and production environments**

Provide maintenance, refresh, patching, configuration alignment, access management, test support, troubleshooting, and lifecycle activities for DEV, TEST, SIT, UAT, PROD, and similar environments.

**Develop automation and operational tooling**

Create and improve scripts, configuration templates, deployment automation, health checks, dashboards, alerts, reporting, and self-service procedures using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices.

**Manage platform lifecycle and vulnerability remediation**

Coordinate version currency, upgrades, patches, vulnerability assessment, remediation plans, exception handling, risk acceptance, end-of-support tracking, and compliance evidence for platform components.

**Lead changes, upgrades, migrations, and recovery tests**

Plan and execute platform upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, certificate renewals, component replacements, backup and restore validation, failover exercises, and disaster recovery tests with controlled business impact.

**Ensure observability and operational reporting**

Define monitoring standards, alert thresholds, service dashboards, availability views, incident trends, capacity reports, and operational KPIs for the supported services.

**Contribute to service governance and compliance**

Maintain architecture records, technical documentation, runbooks, standards, configuration inventories, risk records, audit evidence, operational controls, and support procedures.

**Act as platform subject matter expert**

Provide expert guidance on distributed data platforms, data ingestion, orchestration, resilience, security, platform selection, and operational best practices.

**Participate in on-call, major incident, and problem management**

Support critical incidents, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, permanent corrective actions, and knowledge sharing across operations, engineering, architecture, and application teams.

**Cloudera-Specific Responsibilities**

* Administer Cloudera Data Platform services and supporting components, including Cloudera Manager, HDFS, YARN, Hive, Impala, Spark, Ranger, Atlas, Knox, ZooKeeper, Kerberos, Ozone , OTF Iceberg and related platform services where deployed.

* Monitor and troubleshoot cluster health, HDFS and Ozone capacity, replication, under-replicated data, YARN queues, workload contention, Hive Metastore, Impala admission control, Spark execution, service logs, JVM resources, and host-level dependencies.

* Administer data-platform security, including Kerberos integration, Ranger policies, Knox access, TLS certificates, keytabs, service identities, encryption-related configuration, and audit logging.

* Support backup, restore, replication, disaster recovery, data retention, metadata protection, and recovery testing for platform services and configuration.

* Plan cluster expansion, operating system and Java compatibility changes, platform upgrades, service migrations, storage evolution, and decommissioning of obsolete components.

**Apache NiFi-Specific Responsibilities**

* Administer clustered Apache NiFi environments, including nodes, process groups, processors, controller services, parameter contexts, reporting tasks, connection pools, repositories, and registry integration.

* Operate and troubleshoot data flows, queues, back pressure, provenance, bulletins, failed transactions, state management, priorities, concurrent tasks, scheduling, record processors, and interactions with source and target systems.

* Define standards for reusable flow design, version control, promotion between environments, parameterization, secret handling, naming, documentation, error routing, retry logic, dead-letter patterns, and operational ownership.

* Manage NiFi security, including TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization policies, service accounts, proxy configuration, sensitive properties, and integration with enterprise identity services.

* Plan and execute NiFi upgrades, node replacement, cluster expansion, repository maintenance, certificate renewal, flow migration, backup and recovery activities, and resilience testing.

* Monitor flow throughput, queue growth, back pressure, repository utilization, JVM resources, garbage collection, thread usage, connection status, and end-to-end delivery behavior.

**Apache Airflow-Specific Responsibilities**

* Administer Apache Airflow environments and core components, including schedulers, webservers, triggers, workers, executors, metadata databases, DAG processing, connections, variables, pools, queues, plugins, and providers.

* Operate and troubleshoot DAG parsing, task scheduling, retries, dependencies, sensors, deferrable operators, worker capacity, queue behavior, executor performance, metadata database contention, failed tasks, and scheduler availability.

* Define standards for DAG structure, deployment, version control, environment promotion, secrets, connections, variables, pools, concurrency, retries, alerting, ownership, documentation, and operational readiness.

* Manage Airflow security, including authentication, role-based access control, secrets backends, service identities, TLS, API access, auditability, and integration with enterprise identity and security services.

* Plan and execute Airflow upgrades, provider updates, executor or worker changes, metadata database maintenance, DAG migration, backup and restore validation, and high-availability improvements.

* Monitor scheduler heartbeat, DAG processing time, task latency, queue depth, worker utilization, executor state, triggerer health, metadata database performance, and availability of dependent services.

**Key Required Knowledge and Skills**

* Deep knowledge of distributed data platform operations, data ingestion, batch and streaming integration, workflow orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, metadata, and data lifecycle concepts.

* Hands-on production administration experience with Cloudera Data Platform, Apache NiFi, and Apache Airflow.

* Strong troubleshooting capability across application, platform, JVM, database, operating system, network, storage, and security layers.

* Ability to analyze logs, metrics, traces, service states, resource queues, flow files, back pressure, provenance, DAG runs, task instances, scheduler behavior, and infrastructure dependencies.

* Ability to lead root cause analysis and define permanent corrective actions for recurring platform, integration, workload, or orchestration issues.

* Experience with high availability, clustering, failover, disaster recovery, backup and restore, business continuity, and recovery testing.

* Strong understanding of security controls: Kerberos, TLS, certificates, LDAP/Active Directory integration, role-based access control, Apache Ranger, secrets management, encryption, and audit logging.

* Good scripting and automation skills using Bash, Python, Ansible, Git, CI/CD tooling, or equivalent technologies.

* Strong Linux administration skills and practical knowledge of JVM tuning, systemd, networking, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, storage, databases, and container platforms.

* Knowledge of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, release, configuration, vulnerability, lifecycle, and capacity management.

* Ability to maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, support models, architecture records, operational procedures, and audit evidence.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to coordinate technical activities during incidents, changes, upgrades, migrations, releases, and service improvements.

**Profile required**
--------------------

**Key Required Technologies**

**Cloudera Data Platform**

title: Software Engineer, Embedded & Edge AI
description:
**Description**

Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world’s most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.

**Overview**

Synaptics is looking for talented Software Engineer, Embedded & Edge AI to join our dynamic and growing organization. You will be responsible for the software development for Synaptics Astra® SL Series of Embedded processors. The Astra® SL Series is a family of highly integrated AI-native Linux SoCs optimized for multi-modal Consumer and Industrial IoT workloads with high-performance hardware accelerators for edge-based inferencing, security, graphics, vision and audio. These processors incorporate multiple high-performance compute engines including a quad-core Arm64 CPU subsystem, multi-TOPS NPU, GPU for AI-acceleration and 3D Graphics, along with multimedia accelerators for Image Signal Processing, 4K video encode and decode, backed by industry-grade security certifications. This position reports to the Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibilities & Competencies**

Job Duties

* Developing device drivers for Display/GPU/Camera/HDMI/MIPI as well as the Media/Camera/Graphics framework for our Astra processor series
* Development of bare metal drivers for pre and post silicon bring up
* Work on various Software lifecycle components including requirements analysis, design, implementation, qualification, and production release
* This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a large team around the world working to create revolutionary products

Competencies

* Solid understanding of software system architecture
* Excellent skills in C/C++ programming
* Excellent knowledge of Linux system programming and kernel drivers
* Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment
* Well organized with strong attention to detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Positive attitude and work ethic; unafraid to ask questions and explore new ideas
* Good design, programming, and problem-solving skills and able to solve problems through practical use of technology and a solid understanding of product architecture
* Good verbal and written communication skills, in English
* Strong team player with the ability to work collaboratively within a diverse cross-functional team

**Qualifications** (Requirements)

* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in CSE/ECE from premier institutions or related field or equivalent
* 2+ years of relevant industry experience
* Experience in trusted software development in Secure OS/TEE
* Expertise with systems analysis, profiling, and low-level debugging
* Experience working with firmware/hardware
* Hands on experience in one or more of the areas below
  + Device drivers (Display/GPU/HDMI/HDCP/MIPI/Audio/Camera)
  + Knowledge of functional areas – Display/GPU/MIPI/HDMI/HDCP/Audio/Camera ISP
  + Linux Display/Graphics/Video/Audio subsystem – OpenGL, FB driver, DRM-KMS, V4L2, ALSA
  + Linux graphics stack - Wayland, EGL, X11, Qt5 / Qt6 and QML
  + Media framework – Gstreamer/OpenMax

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

description:

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer to join the Payment Fraud Disruption engineering team within Visa's Ecosystem and Operational Risk organization.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Distributed Systems, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI while building next-generation platforms that help protect the Visa network and drive intelligent risk decisions. As part of an AI-first engineering organization, you will develop large-scale data platforms, real-time streaming solutions, GenAI-powered applications, and agentic workflows that support fraud detection, investigation, risk intelligence, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience in data-intensive systems and a passion for applying Generative AI technologies to solve complex business challenges at scale. The candidate should also bring a reliability-first mindset and an interest in building secure, resilient, observable, and production-ready systems.

What You Will Do:

* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines, APIs, microservices, and distributed applications that power fraud intelligence and risk solutions.
* Develop real-time and batch data-processing applications using modern data engineering technologies.
* Build and integrate Generative AI capabilities such as intelligent search, summarization, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and agent-based workflows.
* Design services for reliability and resiliency by applying patterns such as retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, failure isolation, and graceful degradation.
* Implement monitoring, structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts to improve system visibility and operational readiness.
* Define and monitor service-health indicators across availability, latency, throughput, error rates, data quality, and resource utilization.
* Develop automated unit, integration, performance, resiliency, and deployment-validation tests.
* Identify production risks, system bottlenecks, recurring failures, and performance issues, and contribute to sustainable corrective actions.
* Participate in production support, incident triage, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvement activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, troubleshooting guides, alerts, and runbooks for supported services.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and Security teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, testing, and delivery consistency.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* 6 months to 2 years of software engineering experience developing enterprise applications, data platforms, distributed systems, or cloud-native solutions.
* Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python.
* Experience building APIs, microservices, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience with automated testing, source control, code reviews, and CI/CD practices.
* Foundational understanding of application monitoring, structured logging, alerting, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Kafka, Spark, relational databases, data modeling, and batch or real-time data pipelines.
* Familiarity with LLM applications, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and production troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with resiliency patterns such as retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, and graceful degradation.
* Exposure to performance testing, capacity planning, incident management, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience in fraud, cybersecurity, financial services, or large-scale data platforms is a plus.

title: Sr. System Software Quality Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Sr. System Software Quality Engineer**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD’s quality engineering team is looking for an Associate QA Engineer to build, execute, and scale automated test suites for our core memory-tiering agent and central management platform. You will work closely with developers to ensure the stability of low-level Linux systems and high-performance prefetching engines. You will leverage a comprehensive test environment to practice robust test automation daily, using modern AI tools to accelerate development and focus on the core semantics of test behaviors rather than syntax. While automation is central to scaling and regression, some manual testing is also expected.

**THE PERSON:**

We are looking for a QA Engineer with proven experience in software testing, QA, or systems validation. The candidate will have advanced Linux knowledge and intermediate Python scripting skills, and will bring endless curiosity about how complex, low-level software and hardware systems interact. The engineer will thrive in a fast-moving, high-velocity environment, working independently while managing rapidly changing priorities.

The engineer will engage as an active team player, communicate with empathy across technical and non-technical audiences, and consistently drive to make things better, faster, and more cost-effective.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Write, execute, and maintain automated integration and smoke tests daily using Radish/Cucumber and Python.
* Design and conduct systems-level testing and benchmarking of the memory management platform under real-world workloads.
* Reproduce, troubleshoot, and document field-reported issues within local testbeds.
* Leverage AI coding assistants to automate boilerplate, focusing on system semantics, test design, and edge-case validation.
* Produce clear technical documentation, bug reports, and testing updates.
* Provide operational feedback to the CI/CD team to improve the testing environment.
* Deploy ephemeral test environments on demand via Ansible on GCP or AWS.
* Create new test cases using adhoc or scheduled tests to discover corner case scenarios

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* 9+ years in software testing, QA, or system validation in a product development company
* Advanced Linux knowledge (CLI, system services, core OS concepts).
* Played a key role in Software Quality for an Enterprise class software product.
* Strong scripting skills in C/C++, python etc.
* Implemented process adherence in development environment
* Familiarity with GitHub, Ansible, Cucumber/Radish, and Jira.
* Curiosity about low-level software/hardware interaction.
* Ability to work independently amid rapidly changing priorities.
* Drive to make things better, faster, and more cost-effective.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Expertise in one of the domain (Storage, Process, Post Silicon System Validation etc)

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field preferred, or equivalent.

We are looking for an experienced **SCM Functional Architect** to lead large-scale, enterprise Supply Chain transformation programs built on **Oracle Fusion Cloud**. This is a senior role suited for professionals who combine deep Supply Chain Execution and Planning expertise with strong ERP design capability, and who can operate as a trusted advisor to SCM leadership.

The role will focus on designing integrated Supply chain processes across **Inventory, Product Data Hub (PDH/PIM/PLM), Costing, Procurement, Order Management, Pricing, Supply and Demand Planning.** A key expectation is the ability to translate complex Supply Chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions, ensuring that SCM processes are not implemented in isolation but are aligned across all modules of supply chain

Experience in identifying and solutioning the KDDs must. Especially formation of Procurement organization structure, Inventory Org structure, Costing methods. Should be well conversant with best practices for various Industry Verticals.

The architect will ensure solutions are globally standardized while still supporting necessary regional variations.

Equally important is the ability to articulate business impact. The role requires translating design into measurable business outcomes, including KPIs and enhanced SCM visibility. The architect will play a central role in shaping and governing the **value realization framework**, ensuring that transformation objectives are achieved and sustained.

Candidates must bring strong SCM credentials, preferably **B. Tech or MBA in SCM, logistics or Operations**, combined with a minimum of **15+ years** of experience in SCM transformation programs. Experience in domain like Manufacturing, Procurement etc is advantage. Proven experience in **Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM** is essential.

This role is intended for professionals who can go beyond ERP implementation and act as design authorities—ensuring that finance transformation delivers business outcomes, not just system changes.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
The Lead Software Engineer for Disney Experiences Technology is a subject matter expert and hands-on technical leader who designs, builds, and evolves high-scale software that powers magical, immersive Guest experiences across parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer touchpoints worldwide. In this role, you guide engineering efforts across the stack, mentor other developers, and ensure solutions are robust, performant, and aligned with Disney’s creative, customer-focused, and innovative culture.

**Responsibilities:**

As a Lead Software Engineer, you act as a skilled, experienced subject matter expert and lead, organizing development efforts across UI, services, and integrations to deliver intuitive, high-volume Guest and internal experiences for Disney Experiences brands. You solve complex problems, identify innovative solutions, and serve as a mentor and problem-solver who can explain difficult concepts, influence technical direction, and collaborate as a team player across technology and business partners. This role matters because it connects engineering excellence with Disney’s Guest-centric vision, requiring strong technical depth, communication, collaboration, and accountability to succeed.

* Serve as a subject matter expert and technical lead across the software stack, guiding architecture, design, and implementation for complex, large-scale systems and applications.

* Organize and lead development efforts, including analysis, programming, debugging, and modification of software improvements and new products used across Guest-facing and internal platforms.

* Mentor, train, and guide individual contributors by providing continuous coaching, feedback, and technical oversight, helping them connect their work to team goals and business outcomes.

* Break down organizational and product goals into clear strategies, expectations, and priorities, empowering team members to contribute their unique talents toward well-defined results.

* Lead end-to-end troubleshooting, problem analysis, and incident resolution for high-volume, 24/7 applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and a seamless Guest experience.

* Participate in and often lead agile rituals—such as scrums, sprint planning, capacity tracking, and demos—to align deliverables, manage dependencies, and drive continuous value delivery.

* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and other technology teams to define system requirements, estimate and plan scalable projects, and negotiate solutions that balance technical and business needs.

* Own the design and development of backend services, APIs, and integrations, including security, data flow, and performance considerations for cloud-hosted, distributed systems.

* Stay current with emerging technologies and tools, making informed recommendations that foster creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team.

* Create an environment where Disney values are experienced daily by encouraging collaboration, creative problem solving, accountability, and ensuring every voice is heard.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong subject matter expertise in software engineering, with the ability to lead complex projects and act as a primary technical point of contact for teams and stakeholders.

* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript, Python, or similar, including experience with front-end and service development for high-volume applications.

* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, including security frameworks like OAuth and JWT and integration with cloud hosting environments.

* Familiarity with persistent storage technologies such as relational databases, document databases, caches, and database programming (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, schema design).

* Comfort working in an agile environment, managing team rituals, coordinating releases, and delivering continuous value across large or sophisticated systems.

* Strong problem-solving, analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult concepts, negotiate different points of view, and influence technical direction.

* Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers, hold self and others accountable to commitments, and collaborate effectively as a team-oriented, customer-focused leader.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience.

* Minimum 7 years of industry experience in software development or related work on large, scalable systems and high-scale environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience operating at scale in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP), including observability, performance monitoring, and reliability for 24/7 web applications.

* Background with server-side rendering web frameworks (such as Astro or Angular SSR) to ensure performant, accessible, and SEO-optimized experiences for Disney Parks websites.

* Exposure to AI-related tools or intelligent service integration, and a desire to further develop technical expertise in modern engineering tools and methodologies.

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, and/or relevant professional certifications in software engineering or cloud technologies.

This position is with Disney (India) Private Limited, which is part of a business we call Disney Experiences.

**Candidates Will Have**

* Four-year bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

**Top Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications**

* Experience with Agile delivery methods, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or comparable work-management and service-management tools.
* Experience supporting application-security findings, vulnerability remediation, dependency upgrades, and regression validation.
* Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends, validate business outcomes, define requirements, and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar planning, ordering, product-structure, and application-delivery processes is a plus.

**What You Will Have**

**Business Analysis:** Knowledge of methods for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business requirements; ability to translate stakeholder needs into actionable solution requirements and acceptance criteria.

**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of production application systems used to support internal and external clients; ability to analyze application behavior, dependencies, interfaces, and business impacts.

**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that support structured analysis; ability to interpret business processes and data, identify patterns, and distinguish root causes from symptoms.

**Application Delivery Process:** Knowledge of major delivery tasks, controls, and deliverables; ability to support requirements, testing, release readiness, implementation, and post-production validation.

**System and Technology Integration:** Knowledge of how applications, databases, batch jobs, file transfers, and technology platforms exchange information; ability to analyze and document end-to-end data flows.

**Software Quality Management:** Knowledge of test planning, traceability, defect management, regression testing, and acceptance practices; ability to confirm that delivered solutions meet business expectations.

**Problem Management:** Knowledge of incident investigation and root cause analysis; ability to coordinate corrective and preventive actions for recurring operational issues.

**Information Security Technologies:** Knowledge of application-security concepts and remediation processes; ability to coordinate business-impact assessment, test planning, and validation for security-related changes.

**Stakeholder Management:** Ability to build effective relationships, facilitate decisions, communicate risks and dependencies, and align business and technical teams around clear outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* DOP and Global BOM requirements are clear, complete, actionable, and traceable to business outcomes.
* WD 10 processing is monitored and validated, with timely coordination and transparent stakeholder communication when issues occur.
* Production issues are analyzed efficiently, business impact is understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Enhancements and fixes are thoroughly tested and released with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Application, interface, process, and support documentation remains accurate and usable.
* Business and IT teams work from a shared understanding of scope, priorities, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Continuous-improvement opportunities reduce recurring issues, manual effort, and operational risk.

**What You Will Get**

* Work Life Harmony
* Earned and medical leave.

**Holistic Development**

* Personal and professional development through Caterpillar's employee resource groups across the globe
* Career development opportunities with global prospects

**Health and Wellness**

* Medical, life, and personal accident coverage
* Employee mental wellness assistance program

**Financial Wellness**

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance through the annual incentive bonus plan

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. through the Caterpillar careers website. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply.

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.

title: Senior ABAP Developer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Manager

In this role, you will build and support the SAP ABAP solutions that run our business as one of the first developers on a new central development team. Each day, you will write production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA: reports, enhancements, interfaces, forms, and posting logic. You will work directly with the business users who depend on that code. You will also showcase your experience by taking on work across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales as priorities shift, and by bringing practical clean core judgment to our S/4HANA journey. You will learn and use the agentic AI development platforms the team is adopting, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct.

In this role, you will report to the ABAP Development Lead, work as an individual contributor, and have no people management responsibilities.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. #LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the ABAP Development Lead; functional consultants; the SAP BTP and integration teams; and SAP Basis.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
---------------------------------------

  

* Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC every week, closing your commitments on the date you gave, chasing what is blocked, and following up after go-live until the problem is really solved.
* Bridging to S/4HANA: contributing to S/4HANA Public Cloud stabilization and Private Cloud planning using CDS, RAP and ABAP Cloud, and choosing standard extensibility over classic enhancement where it fits.
* Working directly with the business: sitting with the people who have the problem, understanding the process and configuration behind it, and building what they actually need.
* Working to the team standard: following coding guidelines, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, reviewing colleagues' code, and using AI-assisted development within the team's rules.

**Our team dynamics**

You will become part of a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes and supports one another. AI is part of how we work, and we will help you get started if you are new to it. Done means it is being used by the business, not just transported, and a straightforward “I don’t know yet” is welcome.

**Qualifications for the role**

  

* You have more than 8 years of SAP development experience, with deep current ABAP knowledge in ECC, including enhancements, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, and REST interfaces, plus performance optimization.
* You show a consistent ability to deliver production outcomes that can be measured, including initiatives that were delayed before you inherited them.
* You have practical SAP S/4HANA experience, including CDS views and a solid understanding of clean core principles.
* You enjoy working directly with business users and understanding the process and configuration behind a requirement, not only the specification.
* You have established skills in working to a shared development standard, including code review, ABAP Test Cockpit, and transport discipline, in onshore/offshore or multi-team environments.
* You are open to AI-assisted development and ready to learn agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct. Prior AI experience.
* You are comfortable using English in both conversation and writing.

**What's in it for you?**

You will work on code that keeps a global business running and help shape how a new central team builds. You’ll have direct experience with the latest agentic AI tools for SAP development, along with guidance as you learn them. You can grow into a techno-functional or value stream role, or technical leadership, and we will support you on either path.

At ABB, we help shape digital industries and power grids while supporting sustainable change in a wide range of sectors. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We cultivate a workplace that values diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+ identities, abilities, and generations, so every voice is heard.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Principal Software Engineer (Platform Engineering)
description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

This is a Principal position within the **Platform Engineering** organization. Our core mission is to build the foundational, core common layer across Saviynt engineering, consolidating and centralizing scattered platform tools, workflows, and infrastructure primitives. Wearing a dedicated **Platform Engineering hat**, this role will proactively find opportunities to eliminate operational friction and standardize capabilities into a seamless, unified developer experience.

A primary focus of this role is designing, developing, implementing, rolling out, and supporting our **Internal Developer Platform (IDP)**, fitting all foundational tooling into a cohesive, self-service ecosystem. You will build and implement "golden paths" for developers, creating self-serve platforms embedded with essential security and operational guardrails. Crucially, you will act as a partner across engineering—working closely with developers, Embedded SREs (E-SREs), and Central SRE teams—while actively evangelizing platform products to accelerate adoption throughout the organization.

### **WHAT YOU BRING**

* **12+ Years** of experience across the Software Development lifecycle with a focus on platform engineering, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Proven IDP build experience: you have shipped or significantly contributed to a Backstage or Port portal (or equivalent) used in production.
* Deep Kubernetes expertise across EKS and AKS, including multi-tenant cluster design, Helm, Kustomize, and Crossplane.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS fleet management, cell-based architectures, and ring/canary deployment strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) or Python for building production-grade CLIs, custom operators, or platform backends.
* GitLab CI + ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts pipeline implementation experience—building CI/CD-as-a-service for engineering teams.
* Terraform / OpenTofu module authoring at scale—module registry design, state management, and refactoring large IaC codebases.
* Background in developing Backstage plugins or contributing to open-source developer platform ecosystems.
* Practical application of workload identity, SPIFFE/IRSA, and cloud-native zero-trust network architectures.
* Implementation of OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno for policy-as-code within production-grade Kubernetes clusters.
* Proficiency in FinOps methodologies and tools such as Kubecost or cloud cost exposure APIs.
* Experience managing Kafka or AWS MSK as a multi-tenant platform capability.
* Proven platform-first mindset with a history of centralizing scattered tooling into core foundation layers, evangelizing platform adoption, and collaborating effectively across developers, Embedded SREs, and Central SREs.
* Professional exposure to identity security frameworks, SaaS delivery, and high-compliance operational environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP).

### **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

### **Internal Developer Platform (IDP) & Developer Portal**

* Take ownership of key aspects of the IDP architectural lifecycle, from service catalog creation to automated, self-service environment provisioning.
* Construct and manage a centralized developer hub featuring TechDocs, software catalogs, and seamless integrations with GitLab, Jira, and cloud management consoles.
* Develop and implement "golden-path" templates to rapidly deploy new microservices equipped with Kubernetes configurations, observability tools, and automated security guardrails.
* Champion and evangelize the adoption of platform products across engineering units using developer feedback, usage analytics, and active outreach.

### **Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Fleet Operations**

* Design and support cell-based deployment patterns and progressive ring-deployment strategies across multi-tenant and single-tenant customer fleets to isolate tenant workloads and limit blast radiuses.
* Automate continuous zero-downtime release deployments globally while providing platform abstractions that support multi-region SaaS deployments.

### **Platform-as-a-Service on Kubernetes**

* Design and supervise multi-tenant Kubernetes environments on AWS EKS and Azure AKS, ensuring a unified cluster management experience for internal users.
* Produce modular Helm libraries and infrastructure compositions that mask underlying cloud complexities for product development teams.
* Enforce robust isolation and access control policies that reflect our multi-tenancy security framework at the namespace level.
* Maintain high availability through automated cluster lifecycle operations, including seamless scaling and blue/green deployment rotations.

### **GitOps, CI/CD, and Delivery Infrastructure**

* Drive the evolution of CI/CD-as-a-service by providing standardized pipeline templates via GitLab CI and ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts for effortless team consumption.
* Deploy GitOps methodologies to establish default rollback capabilities, continuous drift detection, and transparent audit trails across environment workflows.
* Incorporate supply-chain security measures, such as container signing and SBOM creation, directly into our core delivery infrastructure.

### **API Gateway, Traffic Management & Edge Infrastructure**

* Manage edge, ingress, and service-to-service communication infrastructure (API gateways, service mesh), incorporating built-in mTLS, rate limiting, distributed tracing context propagation, and circuit breaking as platform primitives.
* Configure global load balancing and edge protection (CDN/WAF) as standardized defaults across developer paths.

### **Infrastructure Automation & IaC**

* Curate a centralized Terraform / OpenTofu registry for multi-cloud resources that adheres to stringent FinOps and security standards by default.
* Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning via Kubernetes-native workflows by implementing advanced provider compositions (Crossplane).
* Engineer custom Go-based CLI tools and operators to automate critical platform tasks, including cost tracking and credential rotation.

### **Platform Observability, FinOps & Resilience**

* Launch a unified observability suite using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to provide teams with essential self-service performance metrics.
* Establish logging and distributed tracing as foundational platform primitives, integrated automatically through standard developer paths.
* Create detailed FinOps reporting mechanisms and real-time cost anomaly guardrails to enable precise cloud expenditure attribution for teams and tenants.
* Integrate chaos testing and automated disaster recovery (DR) failover verification to meet strict enterprise SaaS uptime requirements.

### **Platform Security & Compliance Guardrails by Default**

* Integrate zero-trust principles and workload identity into the platform fabric using short-lived credentials and cloud-native network policies.
* Utilize policy-as-code (OPA, Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and admission controllers to enforce security standards at the cluster level without impeding development velocity.
* Streamline secrets management by providing a secure, automated, self-service platform capability.
* Build compliance-as-code into CI/CD pipelines to automatically generate audit trails and SBOM documentation required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP certifications.

### **Event-Driven & Messaging Infrastructure**

* Manage shared messaging infrastructure systems like Kafka and AWS MSK, delivering topic provisioning and schema management as a robust platform service.
* Construct reusable patterns and scaffold templates that allow product teams to easily implement event-driven architectures from within the IDP.

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

  

***Security & Compliance***  
This role requires adherence to Saviynt’s information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training.  
  
***Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.***

As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we drive improvements into our security products that keep our customers, applications, and devices safe. Security is one of the fastest growing, highly collaborative teams with an entrepreneurial mindset within Microsoft.

The Microsoft Defender family offers comprehensive threat prevention, detection, and response capabilities for everyone – from individuals looking to protect their family to the world’s largest enterprises. Linux servers run highly business-critical workloads for our customers and are increasingly targeted by attackers seeking to disrupt those workloads. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides a security solution to help protect Linux servers with high performance, quality, and innovative security capabilities. We are hiring a Group Engineering Manager for this product area. Our work provides peace of mind to customers by helping them protect their critical assets.

Our team includes people from a wide variety of backgrounds, previous work experiences, and life journeys, and we are eager to maintain and grow that diversity. title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Own the hardest engineering outcomes in X3 and turn architecture direction into working, supportable product capabilities. Set the technical bar across squads while remaining close enough to the code, evidence and customer impact to make sound decisions.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Expert understanding of distributed systems architecture, including domain-driven design, service decomposition, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, scalability, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, consistency models, disaster recovery, observability, and operational excellence.
  
- Extensive experience defining and governing API-first and event-driven platforms, including REST, GraphQL, messaging architectures, service contracts, versioning strategies, backward compatibility, integration governance, and ecosystem extensibility.
  
- Strong engineering and architecture expertise across relational databases and document databases, including platform-scale data modeling, performance optimization, reliability, replication, migration strategies, data lifecycle management, and operational resilience.
  
- Deep experience leading cloud-native engineering initiatives encompassing containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, secure software supply chains, observability, reliability engineering, security architecture, upgrade strategies, and recovery mechanisms.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes.
  
- Demonstrated success leading complex modernization initiatives, balancing legacy constraints, customer continuity, platform evolution, technical debt reduction, and long-term architectural sustainability.
  
- Proven ability to evaluate and govern AI-assisted engineering practices, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, security controls, testing strategies, and operational safeguards.
  
- Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to align engineers, architects, product leaders, operational teams, and executives around complex technical decisions, risks, investments, and trade-offs.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Shape platform capabilities as strategic products that enable engineering velocity, operational excellence, ecosystem extensibility, and long-term scalability across multiple squads and domains.
  
- Define and govern service boundaries, domain ownership models, API contracts, event architectures, distributed systems patterns, and platform standards that remain sustainable as the organization scales.
  
- Establish organization-wide engineering expectations for secure software delivery, supply-chain security, identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, infrastructure automation, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  
- Drive adoption of OpenTelemetry-compatible observability, reliability engineering practices, SLOs, performance management, capacity planning, resilience testing, incident learning, and recovery strategies across engineering teams.
  
- Provide technical leadership for platform engineering capabilities, including containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, developer experience improvements, automation, self-service engineering capabilities, and FinOps optimization where appropriate.
  
- Define and govern compatibility, upgrade, migration, deprecation, recovery, and rollback strategies that protect customer continuity, partner investments, operational stability, and long-term platform evolution.
  
- Mentor senior engineers and technical leaders, establish engineering standards, review architectural direction, and influence cross-functional technical decision-making across the portfolio.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience modernizing large-scale ERP, enterprise business applications, batch-processing platforms, reporting platforms, or complex legacy systems. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are valuable context but are not required.
  
- Deep understanding of ERP, manufacturing, distribution, finance, supply-chain, commerce, or operational workflow domains, including platform modernization, migration, reconciliation, and business continuity.
  
- Experience leading platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, cloud platform transformations, developer-experience initiatives, or internal platform product development.
  
- Experience designing extensible ecosystems, marketplace architectures, partner enablement platforms, metadata-driven platforms, migration factories, or highly configurable enterprise applications.
  
- Experience delivering regulated, highly available, enterprise-scale SaaS platforms with strong requirements for reliability, security, compliance, privacy, auditability, and operational governance.
  
- Experience influencing engineering organizations through architecture governance, technical strategy, technology roadmap definition, engineering excellence programs, and senior technical mentorship.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
- Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant ownership of architecture, platform strategy, distributed systems design, and cross-team technical leadership for large-scale cloud-native products.
  
- Demonstrated success leading major modernization, transformation, platform, or SaaS initiatives that span multiple teams, business domains, and technology stacks.
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  
- Recognized as a trusted technical leader capable of balancing customer outcomes, business priorities, engineering quality, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability.
  
Provide your feedback on BizChat
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- A small number of agreed architecture decisions and transition states guide delivery without blocking squads.
  
- Modern components and contracts reduce coupling, runtime dependency and support effort while preserving customer behaviour.
  
- Critical releases and migration waves have repeatable quality, observability and rollback evidence.
  
- Engineers make more decisions locally because standards, examples and mentoring are clear.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Managers, Principal and Senior Engineers, Automation, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services, partners and Europe/North America domain experts. India delivery is a first-class ownership centre with planned Europe/North America overlap and clear hand-offs across time zones.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Acts as a calm technical role model, makes uncertainty visible, develops talent and chooses the simplest safe path that improves customer and business outcomes.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own cross-squad technical strategy for a significant modernisation outcome, from current-state discovery through a viable transition state and measurable exit criteria.
  
- Make and record decisions on domain boundaries, GraphQL contracts, componentisation, data-path simplification and legacy-runtime reduction.
  
- Lead difficult implementation, incident, performance and migration problems; decide when to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire a capability.
  
- Set engineering standards for secure coding, testing, observability, deployment, upgrades and rollback, and ensure they are adopted rather than merely documented.
  
- Coach senior and developing engineers, grow technical leadership in India and across the distributed squad network, and challenge designs constructively.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Technical direction within the assigned portfolio, cross-squad trade-offs, exception escalation, transition-state design and acceptance of engineering evidence. Escalates product, legal, security or commercial policy decisions with a clear recommendation.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

- Senior Software Engineers are expected to design, build, and operate distributed SaaS platforms, own domain-level architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, mentor engineers, and deliver reliable cloud-native services using technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, while leveraging X3 domain knowledge to accelerate transformation rather than as a prerequisite for hiring.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering commercial products. Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Substantial slices reach production predictably with tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback plans.
  
- Technical debt and coupling are reduced in the owned area without breaking supported customer behaviour.
  
- Code reviews, estimates and incident learning improve squad flow and engineering quality.
  
- Less experienced engineers deliver safely with useful coaching and examples.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Collaborates with Product, Principal/Staff Engineers, Software and Automation Engineers, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and domain specialists in Europe/North America. Owns outcomes from India with deliberate overlap for design and production conversations.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Takes ownership, raises risks early, gives kind and precise feedback, and keeps learning visible.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Break outcomes into sound designs, vertical slices and estimates; deliver production-quality code across services, APIs, UI or data paths.
  
- Make day-to-day technical decisions on component boundaries, GraphQL contracts, PostgreSQL access, observability, test strategy and safe rollout.
  
- Analyse legacy dependencies and contribute to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire decisions with evidence.
  
- Review code and designs, support incident resolution and improve the squad’s automation, documentation and delivery flow.
  
- Pair with and mentor Software Engineers while learning from Principal Engineers and Architects.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Implementation design and sequencing inside the squad, technical risk escalation, test and observability approach, and readiness of owned work for review and release.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.
