description:
Overview:

Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (Java & React)
  
Why HealthEdge?
  
The U.S. healthcare industry is a massive and essential sector, valued at $4.4 trillion. It offers
  
around 1.8 million job openings in the healthcare tech industry annually. This reflects the
  
industry's vast opportunities and the growing need for technological advancements.
  
Specifically, the U.S. health insurance industry, where HealthEdge operates, is valued at $1.1
  
trillion. This sector is known for its stability and sustainability, often remaining resilient during
  
economic downturns and other challenging events.
  
Impact and Scale: HealthEdge serves over 81 million lives by ensuring their health insurance
  
claims are processed quickly and accurately. With more than 130 customers and over 100 third  
party integrations, HealthEdge tackles unique problems at an extraordinary scale daily. We
  
support 48 out of 50 states in the U.S.
  
Innovative Transformation: Founded in 2005, HealthEdge is transitioning from a monolithic
  
application architecture to a modern microservices-based architecture. This involves building
  
new services using microservices and migrating legacy services to modern architecture, one
  
step at a time.
  
Unique Challenges and Opportunities: Working at HealthEdge offers a unique opportunity to
  
gain unmatched experience. Migrating such a large-scale product with hundreds of customers
  
and processing millions of transactions daily presents challenges that are rare in the industry.
  
At HealthEdge, you'll be part of an exciting journey to revolutionize the health insurance industry
  
through innovative technology solutions. We hope you're as excited as we are to take on this
  
challenge and make a significant impact in the healthcare sector.
  
Your Role
  
HealthEdge is looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer who is passionate about solving
  
real-world business problems to join our team. As a Senior member of the team, you will be
  
working on developing solutions that help our customers integrate with our product suite. You
  
will be working as a problem solver with plenty of unique assignments within the department.
  
You will be a key member involved with design discussions, coding on both the backend and
  
frontend, and working heavily with the database and J2EE/integration technologies.
  
Your impact:
  

* Work as part of an agile team to implement new features according to the requirements

while adhering to the best coding development standards.
  

* Conduct detailed designs and lead design whiteboarding and creation of solution

architecture.
  

* Lead in work-breakdown of tasks.
* Lead peer reviews of design and code.
* Coordinate release management and bug triaging.
* Lead technical discussions with HealthEdge customers to find the best possible

solutions.
  

* Conduct bug fixing, implement configuration migration processes, and other UAT

readiness technical tasks.
  

* Perform data loads for UAT readiness and during UAT as requested by the UAT plan.
* Support resolution of UAT identified issues and their triage.
* Contribute to authoring the Implementation Operational Information and companion

spreadsheet for feeds.
  

* Perform configuration migration processes and other PROD readiness technical tasks.
* Perform data loads for PROD readiness.
* Perform all job functions consistent with HealthEdge policies and procedures, including

those which govern handling PHI and PII.
  
Backend Requirements:
  

* Minimum of 6 years of development experience in Java/J2EE technologies.
* Hands-on experience with XML, Web Services (SOAP, WSDL, etc.), JMS, Spring and SQL.
* Experience in complex data analysis, data migrations, and system integration of

software products into complex IT environments.
  

* Experience in writing/understanding quality database queries or stored procedures that

are reliable, scalable, and reusable.
  

* Development experience on the Linux operating system and WebLogic Application

Server.
  

* Experience working with integration middleware or enterprise system bus (ESB)

technologies such as iWay, Spring, or Apache Camel and OSGI containers like Apache
  
Karaf.
  

* Experience with Design Patterns and Enterprise Integration Patterns, including file

transfers, messaging, routing, transforming, enriching, etc.
  

* Experience with source control software (Bitbucket), unit testing (JUnit), and build

automation/CI (Jenkins).
  
Frontend Requirements:
  

* Proficiency in React.js and its core principles.
* Knowledge of React Hooks, Props, Redux, and Reducer framework.
* Experience with useQuery and useMutation APIs.
* Familiarity with Context API.
* Strong understanding of TypeScript.
* Knowledge of Kendo UI is a plus.

Other Details:
  

* BS/BA in CS or related field.
* Excellent analysis, consulting, and communication skills.
* Previous experience in customer-facing roles on professional services engagements.
* Experience in the health insurance industry (Payors) preferred.
* Experience with agile development methodology such as SCRUM or Kanban.
* Travel for this position is typically less than 10%.

title: Full Stack_AI-Native Application Developer.
description:
**A Snapshot of your Day**

We're looking for someone who builds and ships internal, production-grade web applications end-to-end — from a business problem to a live URL people use daily — by directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) rather than hand-writing every line.

This isn't "prompt and hope": it's owning the full lifecycle — architecture calls, integration debugging, production incidents, and the judgment to know when the AI's output needs to be checked rather than trusted.

You'll work largely solo, moving fast between ideas, working prototype, and production deployment, while integrating with real enterprise systems (SSO, mailboxes, databases, cloud infrastructure) that don't forgive sloppy assumptions.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Take a business need directly from a stakeholder (a team lead, an exec, a support team) and turn it into a working Next.js/React app without a formal spec or a dedicated developer team.
* Direct AI coding agents build features, then verify their output against how the system actually behaves — not just whether it compiles.
* Integrate with enterprise identity and data systems: SSO (Cognito + Entra), Microsoft Graph (mailbox/calendar access), shared internal database APIs, cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock)
* Own deployment: CI/CD pipelines, containerized deploys, environment configuration — enough infra literacy to read a failed pipeline and fix it yourself
* Debug production issues by building your own diagnostics (an admin page, a probe endpoint) rather than waiting on someone else's logs
* Recognize the boundary between "I can fix this myself" and "this needs IT/platform team” and write a clear, specific ask when it's the later, instead of thrashing on a workaround
* Test in production and iterate from real usage rather than over-planning up front
* Keep documentation current enough that the next person (or the next AI session) doesn't have to rediscover what you already figured out

**What You Bring**

**Technical**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with minimum 5-6 years of relative experience
* Full-stack web development: React/Next.js, TypeScript, REST APIs
* Cloud fundamentals: AWS IAM, ECS/containers, CloudFormation basics — enough to reason about who owns what permission
* Enterprise auth: OAuth/OIDC, SSO integration (Cognito, Entra ID)
* SQL / relational data modeling, working within a shared/managed database rather than standing up your own
* Git/GitLab, CI/CD pipeline literacy

AI-assisted development ("vibe coding") specifically

* Fluency directing AI coding agents to build real, deployed software — not just toy scripts
* The judgment to catch when an AI's output is subtly wrong (e.g., an IAM policy written for the wrong model version) rather than shipping it as-is
* Comfortable debugging by reading actual system behavior (live API calls, logs, diagnostics) instead of guessing
* Knows the difference between a code problem and an infrastructure/permissions problem — and doesn't burn cycles trying to code around the latter

**Working style**

* Direct communicator — wants the one-sentence answer, not a hedge
* Ships fast, tests in prod, iterates from what breaks
* Comfortable being both the builder and the product owner for what you ship
* Persistent through ambiguous, multi-day infrastructure blockers without losing momentum on everything else

**Nice to have**

* Design-system awareness (brand consistency, accessibility)
* Experience building analytics/reporting features (charting, data taxonomies, dedup pipelines)
* Comfort coordinating directly with IT/platform teams on access and permissions requests
* Candidate will be required to work with USA team and should be comfortable working on US time zones

title: WhatsApp - Software Engineer - Product Generalist
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go — staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation.As a full-stack product engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set direction for a team's technical area, lead major initiatives end to end, and be one of the people the pillar relies on to make the right engineering trade-offs under real ambiguity.  
  
  

### **WhatsApp - Software Engineer - Product Generalist Responsibilities:**

* Build end-to-end product features across client and server, from product definition through rollout and launch.
* Develop reusable software components and APIs for interfacing with back-end platforms, including payments and third-party service integrations.
* Work across a variety of coding languages and technologies, moving to wherever the problem is rather than staying inside one layer of the stack.
* Set direction and goals for a team, lead major initiatives and drive them to completion across functions.
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications, and make the engineering trade-offs a 0-to-1 effort demands.
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt.
* Establish ownership of significant components, features or systems with expert end-to-end understanding.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, help onboard new team members and raise the engineering bar in the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences.
* Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language, or 4+ years of experience with a PhD
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building large-scale applications or similar experience
* Experience in programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Swift or Kotlin, and scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript or Hack
* Experience with API integrations, and exposure to architectural patterns of large-scale software applications
* Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
* In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale
* Experience building payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
* Background in monetization, payments, commerce or AI/ML products
* Experience building 0-to-1 products or standing up new product areas
* Experience with global, multi-market products, particularly in emerging markets
* Experience working with teams distributed across multiple sites
* Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the team:**

We’re the Insurance team at Expedia Group. We build services and customer experiences that help travelers find and manage trip-protection options across brands such as Expedia , Vrbo, and Hotels.com .

Our systems connect insurance suppliers and their products to multiple points in the travel journey, including checkout, post-purchase, and trip management. We focus on making these experiences reliable, clear, and easy to use.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience owning features or components within a service or application from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and support.

Familiarity with low-level system design and developing maintainable, reliable, secure, and operationally resilient software solutions, as well as AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering software products at scale with a focus on performance, accessibility, usability, security, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of production applications.

title: Software Development Engineer 5
description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.

Is this role for you?

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus):**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery:**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity:**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision:**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

  

As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

**Role Summary**

The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.

* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.

* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.

* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.

* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.

* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.

* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.

* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.

* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.

* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).

* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.

* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.

* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.

* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.

* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.

* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.

* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.

* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

**Essential Skills**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale.

* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.

* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.

* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling.

* Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths.

* Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments.

* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.

* Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores.

* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.

* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.

* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).

* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.

* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.

* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).

* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets.

* Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion.

* Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them.

* Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards.

* Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience.

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

You will be tasked with transforming business requirements into robust cloud infrastructure solutions which forms the underlying foundation for all distributed systems and applications of the LSE Group.

  

As a Cloud Platform Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will support and enhance our cloud environment, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and cost-efficiency. This role involves close collaboration with various teams to drive cloud adoption and implement GCP standard methodologies.

Security and Compliance

Automation and DevOps Integration

Agile Practices and Teamwork Tools

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Experience

* Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

  
  

Certifications

Soft Skills

We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. The Google Home team focuses on hardware, software and services offerings for the home, ranging from thermostats to smart displays. The Home team
  
researches, designs, and develops new technologies and hardware to make
  
users’ homes more helpful. Our mission is the helpful home: to create a
  
home that cares for the people inside it and the world around it.

--------------------

* Provide technical leadership on high-impact projects.
* Influence and coach a distributed team of engineers.

* Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection — curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
* Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters — store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations — ensuring architectural coherence across them

Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience — from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. **About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

**Why this team exists**

We run a growing portfolio of consumer businesses — Seekho at scale, alongside several younger products still finding their shape. The reason to build them under one roof is leverage: a new product should launch with login, payments, and notifications already working, and spend its first year on the thing only they can build.

* Build the platform from zero-to-one. Design and ship the IDP — self-service provisioning, paved roads, templates, and golden paths — so product engineers can go from idea to production without filing tickets or waiting on you.
* Lead modernization and transformation as we scale: untangle the early scrappy infra, re-platform what's holding us back, and consolidate tooling before it sprawls.

* Lead architecture decisions for the org: write the design docs, make the calls, and bring the team along. You set the engineering bar through example and mentorship.
* Stay hands-on. This is a coding role. You'll be in the codebase, not just the roadmap.

* Hands-on experience with infrastructure modernization and transformation work.

description:

**Job Description:**

* Ensure consistency through design tokens, theming, component standards, and accessibility requirements.
* Support implementation of responsive and adaptive experiences across devices and platforms.
* Promote adoption of design systems across development teams.

**Engineering Excellence & Quality**

* Establish and promote high standards for code quality, maintainability, scalability, and testability.
* Drive implementation of automated quality practices including:
  + Unit Testing
  + Integration Testing
  + End-to-End Testing
  + Visual Regression Testing
* Lead code reviews and architectural reviews across teams.
* Ensure adherence to:
  + SonarQube quality standards
  + Secure coding practices
  + Open-source governance policies (FOSSA or equivalent)
* Identify and address technical debt while continuously improving engineering quality.

**Performance, Security & Reliability**

* Optimize applications and framework components for:
  + Core Web Vitals
  + Accessibility Compliance
  + Rendering Efficiency
  + Application Scalability
  + Bundle Size Optimization
* Establish performance monitoring and remediation strategies.
* Partner with architects and platform teams to improve reliability and scalability.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical production issues.
* Drive secure development practices and vulnerability remediation activities.

**DevOps & Continuous Delivery**

* Drive adoption of CI/CD best practices across development teams.
* Contribute to pipeline automation, release processes, and deployment strategies.
* Implement and promote:
  + Trunk-Based Development
  + Feature Flags
  + Progressive Delivery
  + Automated Quality Gates
* Support release planning, production readiness, and deployment validation.

**AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation**

* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools to improve developer productivity and accelerate delivery.
* Contribute to initiatives involving:
  + AI-Assisted Development
  + Code Generation
  + Developer Productivity Platforms
  + Design-to-Code Automation
  + Knowledge-Driven Engineering Workflows
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to engineering practices and developer experience.

**Mentorship & Team Enablement**

* Mentor and coach Senior Software Engineers and Software Engineers.
* Lead technical communities of practice, architecture discussions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Guide teams in adopting engineering standards, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
* Influence technical direction without direct people-management responsibilities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with:
  + UI Architects
  + Engineering Managers
  + Product Owners
  + UX and Design Teams
  + Platform Engineering Teams
  + Cloud and DevOps Teams
* Support roadmap planning and technical strategy execution.
* Drive alignment across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* 12–16 years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in front-end development.
* Proven experience leading large-scale front-end engineering initiatives and complex technical programs.
* Strong hands-on expertise in:
  + React
  + Next.js
  + TypeScript
  + JavaScript
  + Web Components
* Experience building reusable frameworks, component libraries, and design-system-driven applications.
* Experience developing scalable enterprise-grade web applications.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and distributed application design.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience.

**Technical Competencies**

**Front-End Technologies**

* React
* Next.js
* TypeScript

* Web Components
* HTML5

**Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Design Systems

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**Your role**  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  
  
**What you will do**  
Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  
Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

  
Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  
**Preferred skills and experience**  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Apex, and working with Salesforce integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), Cloud infrastructure (e.g., GCP), or AI/ML and agentic technologies.

-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. Your work enables our partnership teams to provide strategic, outcomes-focused insights for our top YouTube creators. Outcomes of the team keep the YouTube business organization nimble, able to understand partner needs and innovate accordingly.  
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. --------------------

**About the Role:**  
We are looking for a
  
**Senior**
  
**Oracle CPQ Developer** to join our
  
**Pricing team**. The ideal candidate will be playing a lead role ensuring our partners' requirements are translated into actionable technical designs to be implemented and supported within the Oracle CPQ architecture. The person will work closely with our other developer(s) and pricing operations team to determine how best we can continue to scale our Oracle instance and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
This role will provide guidance to the junior team members and will work as a liaison between technical, functional, business and system integrator teams.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* **Product Catalog Ownership:** Ensure that the product catalog within Oracle CPQ is complete and up to date. Define product attributes and classifications that will be used in pricing rules.
* **Create Pricing Lists and Rules:** Define pricing lists and rules in Oracle CPQ including specifying conditions that trigger the application of pricing rules.
* **Technical Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues related to Oracle CPQ, such as system errors, configuration problems, and integration issues. Work with Oracle Support to address system issues.
* **Rule Logic and Formulas:** Use Oracle CPQ's rule engine to implement pricing logic and formulas. Update configurator models and rules to support business requirement changes.
* **Discount Structures:** Set up discount structures to determine how discounts are applied based on Epsilon's overall pricing strategy, including discount levels and thresholds.
* **Ongoing Monitoring and Maintenance:** Continuously monitor pricing performance and gather feedback. Make adjustments and updates to pricing rules as business objectives and product offerings change. Support Oracle CPQ quarterly updates to ensure system stability.
* **System Deployment** - Responsible for deploying monthly code releases to the Production environment, outside of standard US working hours.
* **User Support** - Provide timely technical support to end-users and ensure minimal downtime. Collaborate with teams to implement patches, upgrades, and configurations.
* **Optimization** - Assist in database performance optimization and query tuning. Identify and recommend process improvements for Oracle systems. Stay up to date with Oracle product releases and patches to determine the impact to the business.
* **CPQ Architecture & Strategy Ownership:**  
  Own the end-to-end Oracle CPQ solution architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with long-term pricing, sales, and digital commerce strategies. Define and maintain CPQ technical roadmaps.
* **Stakeholder & Executive Partnership:**  
  Act as a trusted technical advisor to Pricing, Sales Operations, Finance, IT, and leadership teams. Proactively translate business strategy into CPQ capabilities and influence prioritization decisions.
* **Technical Governance & Best Practices:**  
  Establish and enforce CPQ development standards, design patterns, and coding best practices. Review and approve solution designs, rule logic, integrations, and release plans to ensure quality and consistency.
* **Release & Change Management Leadership:**  
  Lead CPQ release planning, risk assessment, and deployment strategy across environments. Own rollback plans, production readiness reviews, and post-release validation to minimize business disruption.
* **Mentorship & Team Development:**

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  
  
The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  
  
This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  
  
We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations.  
Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials.  
Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide.  
Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them.  
Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners.  
Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.  
  
A day in the life  
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  
  
About the team  
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. description:
**About Analog Devices**

Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Battery Management Systems

Build production software that advances intelligent battery systems across markets

**Role Overview**
=================

Analog Devices Inc. (ADI) is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with four to six years of experience to build and productize software across the complete Battery Management Systems (BMS) stack. You will work from MCU platforms and BMS IC device drivers through battery-algorithm implementation and integration, creating scalable solutions for automotive, energy storage, industrial, robotics, and emerging markets.

This role offers broad technical ownership and the opportunity to solve demanding hardware–software and algorithm-integration problems. You will combine strong Embedded C and Python skills with mathematics, electrical engineering, and systems thinking to deliver efficient, production-quality software for resource-constrained real-time platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Build the complete BMS software stack** , including MCU platform software, hardware abstraction, diagnostics, BMS IC and peripheral device drivers, communication, monitoring, protection, and balancing.
* **Deploy battery algorithms on embedded targets** , translating models and reference code for SOC, SOH, power capability, diagnostics, anomaly detection, and impedance-based functions into deterministic Embedded C.
* **Optimize for real-world constraints** , including execution time, memory, power, numerical accuracy, scaling, and fixed- or floating-point behavior.
* **Scale software across products and markets** through reusable architectures and configurable solutions for multiple MCUs, BMS ICs, toolchains, battery topologies, and operating environments.
* **Create robust Python engineering tools** for automated testing, data processing, visualization, calibration, profiling, and algorithm validation.
* **Own delivery from concept to release** , driving requirements, design, implementation, verification, troubleshooting, reviews, and maintenance in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* B.E. / B.Tech or M.E. / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of embedded software experience in BMS, battery monitoring, power electronics, automotive, energy, industrial, or another safety- and reliability-focused domain.
* Proven delivery of embedded features from requirements and design through integration, verification, and release.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* **Embedded C and Python:** Strong programming skills and the ability to independently develop production embedded software and maintainable tools for automation, testing, data analysis, visualization, and algorithm validation.
* **Embedded systems:** Strong knowledge of MCU architecture, interrupts, timers, memory, DMA, peripherals, boot flow, RTOS or bare-metal systems, communication protocols, build systems, debugging, version control, and continuous integration.
* **BMS and electrical engineering:** Understanding of battery cells and packs, sensing, ADCs, isolation, contactors, protection, balancing, diagnostics, filtering, signal integrity, and basic controls; ability to interpret schematics, data sheets, and timing diagrams.
* **Mathematics and algorithms:** Strong quantitative foundation in calculus, probability, statistics, numerical methods, linear systems, and signal processing, with practical understanding of precision, scaling, overflow, error, and computational complexity.
* **Engineering quality:** Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, supported by disciplined requirements, design, review, configuration management, testing, traceability, and defect management practices.

**Behavioral Expectations – Senior Engineer**
---------------------------------------------

* Take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality results.
* Use structured, data-driven thinking to solve complex and ambiguous problems.
* Collaborate effectively and communicate decisions, risks, and results clearly.
* Adapt, share knowledge, support colleagues, and continuously improve.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with SOC, SOH, state-of-power, impedance, estimation, prediction, or diagnostic algorithms.
* Exposure to MATLAB/Simulink, model-based development, code generation, calibration, or algorithm prototyping.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, functional safety, cybersecurity, Automotive SPICE, MISRA C, static analysis, performance optimization, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or data-driven battery analytics.

**Why Join ADI?**
-----------------

* **Own meaningful technical challenges** across the full BMS software stack and product lifecycle.
* **Build solutions with market impact** across automotive, energy storage, industrial, robotics, and emerging applications.
* **Grow with a strong engineering community** that values technical depth, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Do you want to build secure, scalable cloud controls that protect a large Azure-managed environment while enabling customer-facing teams to move quickly?

The Azure Managed Environment team provides governed Azure tenants and subscriptions for customer demonstrations, proofs of concept, support engineering, and other non-production scenarios. The service applies centralized policy, monitoring, automated remediation, lifecycle governance, and cost controls to reduce production-tenant exposure, limit shadow IT, and preserve delivery agility.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate automated control solutions that enforce security and governance requirements across this environment. You will translate SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and business requirements into scalable policies, automations, telemetry, and remediation workflows.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines software engineering, cloud security, operational judgment, and cross-functional leadership. You will partner with security architects, service owners, support teams, and business stakeholders to improve control effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the resilience of the managed environment.

  
**Responsibilities**

* Engineer cloud controls: Design and develop reusable Azure Policy definitions, policy initiatives, automation, and remediation workflows that enforce security and governance requirements across managed tenants and subscriptions.
* Lead control implementation: Assess new SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and internal control requirements; determine affected resources and control gaps; and lead architecture, implementation, validation, and rollout.
* Build compliance by design: Embed secure defaults, configuration standards, monitoring, and automated remediation into provisioning and lifecycle processes so compliance is consistent and scalable.
* Own engineering quality: Establish design standards, code-review practices, testing, release controls, documentation, and operational readiness for cloud-control solutions.
* Improve detection and remediation: Use telemetry, execution logs, and control-effectiveness measures to identify failures, tune enforcement, reduce false positives, and accelerate risk reduction.
* Advance lifecycle and cost governance: Engineer solutions for tenant and subscription provisioning, renewal, decommissioning, ownership hygiene, resource governance, allowance management, and cost optimization.
* Automate repeatable operations: Replace manual processes and one-off scripts with durable services, APIs, pipelines, and AI-enabled engineering approaches where appropriate.
* Support operational resilience: Provide engineering leadership during complex incidents and escalations, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Partner across functions: Work with service owners, security and privacy teams, platform engineering, finance, support, and business stakeholders to align requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers, communicate design and risk tradeoffs clearly, and influence decisions without relying on direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience using one or more general-purpose languages, scripting languages, or infrastructure-as-code technologies; OR a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 1+ years of relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value.
* Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-quality cloud services, automation, or platform engineering solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Policy, Azure Resource Manager, identity and access management, monitoring, or subscription and tenant governance.
* Understanding of secure software development, cloud security controls, least privilege, configuration management, and automated compliance.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues, use telemetry to drive decisions, and lead remediation across multiple teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and risk tradeoffs to engineering and business audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C#, Python, PowerShell, TypeScript, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps or GitHub pipelines, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building Azure Policy definitions and initiatives, policy-as-code solutions, automated remediation, compliance dashboards, or control-evidence pipelines.
* Knowledge of Azure landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, Entra ID, role-based access control, resource lifecycle management, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience operating services at enterprise scale, including incident response, root-cause analysis, health service monitoring, and reliability improvement.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to engineering productivity, operations, detection, or remediation.
* Relevant Azure, security, DevOps, or cloud architecture certification.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

description:

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world.
