Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Principal Storage Software Engineer – Cloud & Distributed Storage**
=====================================================================

**About the Role**
------------------

* We are looking for a highly experienced Storage Software Engineer with 15+ years of software engineering experience to architect, design, and build highly scalable Block, File, and Object Storage platforms and database-aware storage platforms running in Kubernetes environments.
* This role is ideal for a senior technical leader who can architect, design, code, influence, and own complex storage systems end-to-end. You will play a key role in defining the technical direction and evolution of our storage platform while driving engineering excellence and raising the technical bar across the organization.
* This is a deeply hands-on engineering role that combines strong systems programming and coding skills with storage architecture, distributed systems expertise, and technical leadership. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defining long-term architecture, writing production-quality code, solving complex performance and reliability problems, and guiding engineers through the design and delivery of large-scale storage systems.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Architect and develop highly scalable block, file, and object storage systems.
* Build database-aware storage optimized for PostgreSQL, relational databases, distributed databases, and other stateful workloads.
* Use AI coding agents to your advantage to boost productivity and lead us to the future of AI native engineering. Capable of giving the right context and detailed requirements to the Agent.
* Design storage data planes and control planes for Kubernetes environments.
* Develop Kubernetes-native storage integrations using CSI, operators, controllers, CRDs, and storage classes.
* Write production-quality systems software in C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Design for high availability, data durability, fault tolerance, replication, recovery, snapshots, cloning, and disaster recovery.
* Optimize storage for IOPS, throughput, latency, tail latency, CPU efficiency, and network utilization.
* Debug complex problems across databases, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and storage layers.
* Lead architecture and design reviews and establish technical direction for storage platforms.
* Mentor engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with architecture, design, coding, and troubleshooting.
* Be responsible for the outcome of the domain’s work.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering.
* 15-18 years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in storage, distributed systems, databases, or infrastructure software.
* Deep knowledge of storage domains: block, file, object, or database storage.
* Strong systems programming skills in C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Strong understanding of Linux storage and I/O architecture.
* Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.
* Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure experience.
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts including replication, consensus, consistency, failure detection, data placement, and recovery.
* Experience with storage technologies and protocols such as NVMe, NVMe-oF, SCSI/iSCSI, UBD, S3, CSI, io\_uring, SPDK, or similar technologies.
* Ability to lead technically while remaining a hands-on engineer who designs, codes, reviews, benchmarks, and debugs production systems.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------

As a Principal Engineer, you will help define the long-term technical direction for our storage platform. You will work across storage, database, Kubernetes, networking, hardware, and infrastructure engineering teams to build reliable, high-performance storage services for business-critical workloads.

We are looking for an engineer who can operate from architecture to code to production—someone who can design the system, build critical components, analyze performance, diagnose difficult failures, and lead other engineers in delivering storage infrastructure at scale.

description:

1. Requirement Analysis:

* Translate business requirements into technical solutions, specifically around automation.

2. Design and Architecture:

* Develop automation scripts, workflows, and integrations using ServiceNow platform features like Flow Designer and ServiceNow Orchestration.

3. Development:

4. Integration:

5. Testing & Debugging:

6. Maintenance & Optimization:

7. Documentation:

8. Collaboration:

title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**About the Team**
------------------

Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Set the direction:**

* Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team.
* Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community
* Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you.
* Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar.
* Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate.
* Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it.

**Own the Platform:**

* Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from.
* Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting.
* Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples.
* Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions
* Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title.
* Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several.
* Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling.
* A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages.
* Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority.

**Nice to have**

* Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects.
* Building with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks.
* Designing resilient clients: authentication flows, retries and rate limiting.
* Setting up GitHub Actions and release automation.
* Working in authorization or identity, such as OAuth, RBAC or ReBAC.

title: Software Engineer - Model API Platform
description:
**About Sarvam**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC and LIC.

**About the role**

Sarvam's model APIs (ASR, TTS, Vision, LLM, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. The platform handles tens of millions of API calls every day, over HTTP and WebSockets, with metering, billing, prepaid wallets and rate-limiting all part of the same stack.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to own major parts of this platform end to end, working closely with the Staff Engineer who leads its architecture. You will take an area such as speech to text pipeline,or text to speech pipeline, and be accountable for its reliability, performance and end-to-end latencies. This role is for someone who is obsessed with latencies, optimizes services and network paths to shave off milliseconds, ships fast, reasons from first principles, and treats AI as the default way to get engineering work done.

**What you will do**

**Own a platform area end to end**

* Own one or more major parts of the platform, such as the WebSocket streaming layer, a speech recognition pipeline, or text to speech pipeline: build, operate and improve them.
* Turn loosely defined goals into RFCs, milestones and shipped results, and write down the decisions and trade-offs.
* Be accountable after launch: on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-through on fixes.
* Make the call when a decision is needed, and own the outcome.
* Obsessed with latencies, dissecting existing services to understand the system, and tuning the right knobs to optimize performance.
* Bring services across without regressions in customer-facing APIs, latency or reliability.

**Build real-time and model-serving pipelines**

* Build and operate streaming infrastructure: WebSocket connections, long-lived sessions queue-based batch processing, backpressure and low-latency model invocation.
* Engineer audio pipelines: TTS chunking around model context limits, sample-rate conversion and format encoding, and VAD-based silence detection for ASR.
* Hold your services to sub-100ms latency SLOs in a multi-tenant environment, and know where every millisecond goes.

**Think in systems and from first principles**

* Reasons from constraints: latency budgets per hop, throughput, cost per request, failure modes and tenant isolation.
* Use back-of-the-envelope estimates to decide what to build, what to optimize and what to leave alone.
* Prefer simple designs you can fully explain over clever ones you cannot.
* Build in observability from day one: logging, metrics and tracing that let anyone debug production quickly.

**Raise the bar for the team**

* Strengthen the integration testing harness so the team can ship fast without breaking customer-facing APIs.
* Partner with the Inference and MLOps teams on making model serving fast, reliable and operable.
* Mentor junior engineers through RFC reviews, code review and pairing.
* Practice design-first, documentation-first engineering: RFCs before code, no tribal knowledge.

**What we are looking for**

* 4–6 years of building and operating production backend systems.
* At least one service you owned end to end under real load, including what broke and what you changed.
* Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, queues, caching, consistency and failure modes.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput services, and comfort reasoning about p95 and p99 latency.
* Solid fundamentals with a relational database and a cache, such as PostgreSQL and Redis: schema design, query performance and caching strategy.
* Fluency in at least one backend language and willingness to work in both Python and Golang.
* Experience running services with containers, CI/CD and production monitoring.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, with concrete examples of what you automated or sped up.
* A bias for action: fast on reversible decisions, careful on irreversible ones.
* Clear writing, especially RFCs and design docs that others can act on.

**Good to have (not required)**

* Voice AI or real-time audio experience: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming ASR or TTS, or audio processing with FFmpeg or pyav, codecs, sample rates and VAD.
* Production experience in Go, or in Python with FastAPI.
* Experience serving LLM, ASR, TTS or vision models in production.
* Experience building metering, billing, wallet or payments infrastructure.
* Running services on Kubernetes in production.
* Time at an early- or growth-stage startup.

**Why Sarvam**

* A fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, with real population-scale impact.
* Researchers, engineers, builders and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.
* High ownership and high impact from day one.
* AI-first in everything, from how we build and ship to how we think about problems

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**

People & Work Intelligence (PWI) is building the intelligence layer that helps Microsoft 365 understand the work people do, the skills they possess, and how AI can accelerate workforce transformation. Our platform powers experiences across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Workforce Intelligence, Learning, Skills, Tasks, and organizational insights, enabling AI-driven decision making for individuals, managers, and enterprise leaders.

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to help build and evolve PWI’s intelligence, inferencing, platform, and AI-powered systems.

This role is ideal for a solid, hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, building reliable distributed systems, and applying modern AI technologies to real-world product scenarios. You will work on systems that process signals from Microsoft 365, generate meaningful intelligence, and power experiences across Copilot and People & Work Intelligence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own significant components and technical areas from design through production. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product management, data science, research, and partner teams to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.

Success in this role requires solid engineering fundamentals, experience building production services, sound technical judgment, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. You will also contribute to engineering quality, mentor other engineers, participate in design reviews, and help the team adopt modern AI-first engineering practices.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **About Okta**

Okta is an enterprise grade identity management service, built from the ground up in the cloud and delivered with an unwavering focus on customer success. With Okta you can manage access across any application, person, or device. Whether the people are employees, partners, or customers, or the applications are in the cloud, on premises, or on a mobile device, Okta helps you become more secure, make people more productive, and maintain compliance.

The Okta service provides directory services, single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, workflow, and built in reporting. It runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform and integrates deeply with on premises applications, directories, and identity management systems.

### **About the Team**

The Data Platform team is responsible for the foundational data services, systems, and data products for Okta that benefit our users. Today, the Data Platform team solves challenges and enables:

* Streaming analytics
* Interactive end-user reporting
* Data and ML platform for Okta to scale
* Telemetry of our products and data

Our elite team is fast, creative and flexible. We encourage ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies and the chance to have significant equity in a company. Okta is about to change the cloud computing landscape forever.

### **About the Position**

This is an opportunity for experienced Software Engineers to join our fast growing Data Platform organization that is passionate about scaling high volume, low-latency, distributed data-platform services & data products. In this role, you will get to work with engineers throughout the organization to build foundational infrastructure that allows Okta to scale for years to come. As a member of the Data Platform team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying the systems that power our data analytics and ML. Our analytics infrastructure stack sits on top of many modern technologies, including Kinesis, Flink, ElasticSearch, and Snowflake.

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers who can help design and own the building, deploying and optimizing the streaming infrastructure. This project has a directive from engineering leadership to make OKTA a leader in the use of data and machine learning to improve end-user security and to expand that core-competency across the rest of engineering. You will have a sizable impact on the direction, design & implementation of the solutions to these problems.

### **Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement and own data-intensive, high-performance, scalable platform components
* Work with engineering teams, architects and cross functional partners on the development of projects, design, and implementation
* Conduct and participate in design reviews, code reviews, analysis, and performance tuning
* Coach and mentor engineers to help scale up the engineering organization
* Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack

  

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* 4+ years of experience of software development

* Proficient in at least one language while comfortable in more than one of the backend languages, preferably Java or Typescript, Ruby, GoLang, Python.
* Have experience working with at least one of the database technologies - MySQL, Redis, or PostgreSQL.
* Demonstrable knowledge of computer science fundamentals with strong API Design skills.
* Comfortable working on a geographically distributed extended team. Brings the right attitude to the team: ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and customer focus.
* Track record of delivering work incrementally to get feedback and iterating over solutions.
* Comfortable in React or similar front-end UI stacks; if not comfortable yet, you are willing to learn

### **Nice to have**

* Experience using a cloud-based distributed computing technologies such as
* + Messaging systems such as Kinesis, Kafka
  + Data processing systems like Flink, Spark, Beam
  + Storage & Compute systems such as Snowflake, Hadoop
  + Coordinators and schedulers like the ones in Kubernetes, Hadoop, Mesos
* Maintained security, encryption, identity management, or authentication infrastructure
* Leveraged major public cloud providers to build mission-critical, high volume services
* Hands-on experience in developing Data Integration applications for large scale (petabyte scale) environments with experience in both batch and online systems.
* Contributed to the development of distributed systems or used one or more at high volume or criticality such as Kafka or Hadoop

* Lead technical analysis and solution design together with business stakeholders, architects and business analysts, translating requirements into scalable designs, estimates and technical specifications

* Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, accessibility, compliance and operational requirements

* Minimum 8 years of experience designing, developing and maintaining enterprise SharePoint solutions

* Solid hands-on experience with SharePoint Online, SPFx, React, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, PowerShell and Azure services

* Experience delivering modern intranets, collaboration platforms, document management solutions and business applications

* Good knowledge of SharePoint information architecture, search, permissions, security, governance and lifecycle management

* Experience modernizing or migrating SharePoint on-premises solutions to SharePoint Online, with a university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.

title: Lead Software Engineer - FinOps, Cloud Platform
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

At Chase International Consumer Bank, we are building a digital bank from the ground up, combining the agility of a modern engineering organization with the scale of a trusted global brand. As a Lead Software Engineer \- FinOps (Vice President) within JPMorganChase International Consumer Bank, you will be a hands\-on engineering leader helping Chase UK build and run cloud\-native capabilities that improve unit economics, reliability, and platform eMiciency across our public cloud footprint, primarily AWS.




You will design and deliver engineering solutions that make cloud financial management actionable through software, automation, and policy\-as\-code guardrails. You will partner closely with application, platform, and SRE/DevOps teams to influence architecture and delivery practices, and to embed strong engineering standards into day\-to\-day workflows.




You will operate in a modern cloud stack (AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, event\-driven components) and drive improvements across Kubernetes engineering, automation runbooks, and developer experience. Go is the primary language for application development in this role, with Python as a valuable secondary skill for tooling and automation. Good\-to\-have platform tooling includes GitHub Actions, Argo CD, and control\-plane automation approaches like Crossplane, as well as strong AWS solutions architecture depth.




**Job responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain backend services and automation in the cloud financial management space. The software you deliver will support cost tracking, allocation, governance, compliance, and reporting for teams running workloads on AWS (primary) and GCP (secondary).
* Deliver production\-grade software with strong engineering discipline, including clear design, code reviews, secure coding practices, and appropriate automated testing.
* Apply solid Kubernetes fundamentals to build practical solutions and standards, including resource requests and limits, scaling behaviour, workload placement, and safe operation of shared clusters.
* Create dashboards and engineering\-facing views that connect usage, performance, and scaling Behaviour to cost outcomes, and help teams act on the results.
* Build Kubernetes automation that improves eMiciency and reduces waste using proven tools and patterns such as Karpenter for node provisioning and right\-sizing, and KEDA for event\-driven scaling, along with custom automation where needed.
* Contribute to platform management and platform development practices, including cluster lifecycle and upgrades, platform reliability, standard templates, paved paths, and developer self\-service capabilities.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for services and platform components to enable repeatable, low\-risk releases, with strong visibility and rollback practices.
* Work closely with application teams, SRE/DevOps, and leadership to drive adoption of eMicient cloud patterns, and to ensure improvements are delivered and sustained in production.
* Bring strong cloud financial management knowledge to daily engineering work, including cost allocation and tagging hygiene, anomaly investigation, budget and forecast inputs, and measurement of realized impact.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Strong hands\-on software engineering experience building and operating backend services in production, with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Go as the primary language for application development; Python is a strong for tooling, scripting, and automation.
* Strong Kubernetes fundamentals and practical experience running workloads on Kubernetes (ideally EKS), including debugging, scaling, performance tuning, and safe operation of shared clusters.
* Strong knowledge of cloud financial management and cost governance on AWS, including cost allocation, tagging strategy, anomaly investigation, budgeting and forecasting inputs, and measuring realized savings.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS cost optimization levers beyond discount programs, including right\-sizing, scaling strategies, storage lifecycle choices, and architecture decisions that improve unit economics.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and control\-plane automation, including Terraform and Crossplane.
* Working knowledge of AWS networking and distributed systems fundamentals needed to build scalable and cost\-aware systems.
* Strong DevOps and SDLC practices, including code reviews, test automation, secure coding practices, and operational ownership.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for services and platform components, including GitHub Actions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills; comfortable working with cost and usage datasets to spot trends and drive practical engineering changes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to partner eMectively across platform, application, and operations teams to drive changes through to production




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience with Kubernetes eMiciency and scaling tooling such as Karpenter and KEDA.
* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud cost visibility and optimization tools such as Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), AWS Compute Optimizer, and CloudWatch.
* Familiarity with broader cost governance and observability tooling (for example Grafana, QuickSight, Flexera) and the ability to turn data into actionable engineering work.
* GitOps and deployment tooling exposure such as Argo CD.
* Exposure to GCP billing and cost management concepts in addition to AWS

**About Starburst**
-------------------



Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. We operate with startup speed inside an enterprise company, shipping weekly and measuring results. This is the first dedicated platform engineering hire on the team.


#### **Role Summary**



You will build the shared development primitives that make multiple product teams faster, with clean abstractions across the Python/JVM boundary. This role is a force multiplier: instead of building product features directly, you build the platform, SDK, and tooling that enables every other engineer on the team to ship faster.



You will own the developer experience for agent development at Starburst, building from 0 to 1 and scaling across teams. Your work is measured by other engineers' velocity, not your own feature output.


#### **As an AI Platform Engineer at Starburst, you will:**


* Design and build an agent development SDK that abstracts common patterns (tool registration, context management, evaluation hooks, prompt management)

* Create developer tooling: local development environments, debugging tools, test harnesses, CI integration
* Define and maintain API contracts between the AI layer and the Starburst platform
* Build shared infrastructure: model gateway, observability pipeline, experiment framework
* Develop unified, product\-agnostic components used across multiple products
* Own platform health beyond feature delivery: performance, reliability, developer ergonomics

#### **Some of the things that we look for:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling
* Proficiency in both Python and JVM languages (Java or Kotlin)
* Experience designing APIs and SDKs consumed by other engineering teams
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals: RPC, serialization, error handling, observability
* Experience with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
* Track record of building tools that measurably improve other engineers' velocity

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with LLM integration patterns: model APIs, token management, streaming, tool use
* Experience with cross\-language interop (gRPC, FFI, language bridges)
* Open\-source contributions to developer tooling or infrastructure projects
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and experiment infrastructure
* Experience supporting both research and production workloads on the same platform

* **Ability to Travel**: This role will require 25% in\-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

All\-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open\-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on\-prem or in the cloud.


We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes\-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.

* You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU\- and DPU\-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.
* Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.
* Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.
* Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.
* Help steward an open\-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.

**What we need to see:**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on software engineering.
* Expert\-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture
* Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands\-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab \& ArgoCD.
* Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix\-like kernels such as Linux.

A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs c. 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains.


**We Offer**

Joining Maersk will embark you on a transformational journey with great opportunities for career development within a global organization. As a Senior OSS Engineer, you will design, engineer and run our capabilities for the Operational Support Systems (OSS) and Tools stack for network and perimeter products and platforms that enable highly distributed global business for site, fleet, asset and IoT connectivity, required to deliver against our strategy. You will be exposed to a wide and challenging range of needs and opportunities requiring you to engage closely with stakeholders across all levels within Maersk as you mature and evolve our OSS capabilities for Network OSS to become world class.


**The Brief**

A globally focused shipping and transportation organisation is continuing to drive an ambitious and complex change and transformational programme to deliver a service of excellence for its customers and clients worldwide. The Global CTIO has a mandate from the Maersk board to lead the Technology transformation of Maersk which will enable the Maersk business strategy to become the global integrator of container logistics through digitising the Maersk business processes and customer engagement.


The Technology Function is fundamental to enable the company’s transformation and in response to this demand, our in\-house technological capability is growing exponentially. We are recruiting world class talent to ensure that the technology services are modernised to enable Maersk to become a logistics integrator leveraging a competitive advantage through technology.


**Why this job matters?** 

The Network OSS Engineering function is essential to our transformation, it is a central team within Network Architecture \& Engineering, responsible for the delivery of product roadmaps, technical vision and quality across Fulfilment and Assurance that underpin our network and perimeter capabilities and products.


Reporting to the Senior OSS Engineering Manager you will serve as a Senior OSS Engineer, ensuring that our systems and tools for the network OSS realise business value. Your role is responsible for technical design and delivery of solutions across the network OSS applications landscape from monitoring to analytics driven AIOps. All built to industry leading standards and running seamlessly across various cloud and on\-prem platforms, allowing frictionless and seamless operations of our network and perimeter platforms.


It has a critical role to play as we continue to develop our long\-term multi\-technology and multi\-product network and perimeter capabilities, connecting our asset, sites and people on land and at sea. Delivering best in class software and tooling that not only meet the need of our business today but will be a differentiator, enabling our colleagues and partners with technology solutions that are a catalyst for productivity and innovation.


**Scope**

All data networks provided to Maersk across Core, Edge and Cloud locations (offices, warehouses, terminals, vessels, data centres, cloud etc), and the perimeter services that protect and enable them including but not limited to:


* Wireless Transport: Satellite \| 4G/LTE \| 5G
* IoT Networking Solutions: Industrial Wi\-Fi
* WAN: Internet \| IP/MPLS \| Next\-Gen/SD WAN
* LAN: DC Networking \| SDN \| Fixed \& Wireless
* Perimeter: Load balancers \| NG Firewalls \| Security Service Edge

**Specific Job Requirements**

The role holder shall possess a solid understanding of DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, Jenkins, build pipelines and source control systems and have a working knowledge of cloud infrastructure services: compute, storage, networking, hybrid connectivity, monitoring/logging, security and IAM.


Collaborate with stakeholders and Business Analysts to gather, document and understand requirements. Articulate functional and non\-functional requirements to business and technical stakeholders.


Product mindset and passion about building for internal stakeholders and external customers.


Work with product owners to prioritize features for ongoing sprints and implement features based on service line demand, industry trends, known defects, and issues.


To be a successful technologist at Maersk, you must be passionate about building, enabling and sustaining our business, as well as inspiring and developing our people. Further, in this role you will:


* Be a world class expert in the OSS domain, implementing the defined architectural roadmap for Network tooling for the Maersk Group.
* Support delivery and program management with estimations and planning.
* Validate all the Non\-Functional requirements and provide inputs to the applications team on capacity exercise.
* Practice TDD and follow best practices.
* Produce high\-quality, clean and performant code.
* Implement and publish APIs for ecosystem clients to consume platform services in a consistent way.
* Adopt a product mindset and passion about building for internal and external ecosystem.

What I'll be doing – your accountabilities?


**Software Engineering** – Build and integrate applications in the OSS ecosystem. Engineering of the software tools to drive Fulfilment and Assurance OSS capability to underpin all networking and perimeter services across Core, Edge and Cloud. To be considered for this opportunity the candidate needs to have following technical qualifications:


* Expertise in building/troubleshooting and debugging containerized applications using Kubernetes using microservices concepts like observability and scalability.
* Excellent experience and knowledge of Java 17\+. Well versed with Spring boot.
* TDD with Unit Testing (such as Junit or Mockito) and Integration Testing.
* Strong experience with Python, API development and testing tools such as Postman, and automation scripting, with the ability to develop production\-ready services, integrations and proofs of concept for observability, AIOps and agentic AI use cases.
* Hands\-on experience with microservices, container and cloud technologies, ingress controllers, API gateways, PromQL and LogQL.
* SRE Exposure an advantage. Experience defining service KPIs, SLIs and SLOs using open\-source observability tooling such as Prometheus, Mimir, Grafana, Loki and ELK, together with instrumentation, telemetry and log analytics.
* Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL, Streaming (Kafka) and large\-scale batch processing
* Experience with frontend technologies like react/angular etc. is desirable
* Solid experience in DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, build pipelines and source control systems
* Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integrating platforms through webhooks and event\-driven interfaces.
* Experience monitoring application performance, resolving production issues and operating services using SRE practices.
* Comfortable working in agile methodologies (ideally Scrum)

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.  



We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com .

title: Senior Thunderhead/SmartDX Developer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

J.P. Morgan Commercial Investment Bank is a global leader in investment and wealth management, serving institutions, high\-net\-worth individuals, and retail investors worldwide.

  

  

As a Project Manager within OTC Derivatives \& Structured Securitization Technology, you architect, design, build, and maintain high\-quality document solutions to streamline business processes. You develop structured templates and integrations, partnering with business, IT, DevOps, and cloud teams across the full development lifecycle from requirements through deployment and support. You drive production readiness through UAT coordination, governance and documentation, performance tuning, and effective prioritization in a fast\-paced environment.


Job Responsibilities


* Architect SmartDX/Thunderhead document solutions across OTC Derivatives and Structured Securitization products to standardize and streamline workflows.
* Develop structured, data\-driven templates using XML, JSON, and XPath aligned to business requirements.
* Enhance document automation using scripting such as JavaScript and PowerShell to improve flexibility and maintainability.
* Integrate SmartComms solutions with upstream/downstream systems via REST/SOAP APIs to enable end\-to\-end automation.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs and working implementations across all SDLC stages.
* Partner with IT, DevOps, and cloud teams to support regression testing, CI/CD deployments, release management, and ongoing maintenance.
* Proactively conduct UAT support, troubleshooting, and performance tuning/optimization of the document generation process while driving best practices, documentation, and governance.
  

  

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities


* Hands\-on experience building and supporting SmartDX/Thunderhead (SmartComms) document solutions in an enterprise environment
* Strong development capability with XML, JSON, and XPath for structured template design
* Proficiency in Java and JavaScript for solution development and automation scripting
* Experience with API integration (REST/SOAP), CI/CD pipelines, and version control tools such as Git/Bitbucket
  

  

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities


* Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python
* Hands\-on exposure to SmartIQ and RPA tools such as UiPath
* Cross\-asset FX/Derivatives experience within a global financial institution
* Practical understanding of front\-to\-back business processes for OTC and securitized derivative products

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B\+ business and one of the fastest\-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  

  

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  

  

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off\-the\-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  

  

We're an AI\-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

  

A day in the life  

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday\-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  

  

About the team  

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast\-moving group solving open\-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior SCALA Developer
description:
About This Role
**4 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: SCALA**

**Overview**
------------


The client uses the Scala Digital Signage platform in a highly customized manner. While Scala's networking, player\-management, publishing, and status capabilities are generally used as designed, most of the content displayed on screen is generated programmatically. Scala's native content\-authoring tools provide the presentation shell, while custom Python software controls much of the actual content, behavior, event processing, and external\-system interaction.


An engineer supporting this environment must first understand how to design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot an enterprise\-scale digital signage system. This includes recognizing normal production behavior, identifying conditions that require intervention, and diagnosing issues across the signage platform, players, networking, content, data sources, and display hardware.


The engineer must understand Scala Content Manager and its use of FrameSets, Screen Regions, Playlists, Channels, Scheduling, and Content to organize and publish presentations. They must also understand Scala's content\-creation environment, content deployment and troubleshooting, metadata\-driven configuration, and the mechanisms used to execute Python applications within Scala content.


Because the majority of the client's dynamic content is generated programmatically, advanced Python software\-development skills are essential. The current implementation uses an object\-oriented, class\-based architecture designed to support multiple content variations while sharing a common application platform.


A major portion of the environment has been modernized from tightly coupled, content\-specific Python applications into a reusable software architecture. Shared functionality such as event handling, network communication, configuration, logging, data processing, and common runtime services is implemented in reusable Python libraries. Individual signage applications primarily define content\-specific behavior while relying on the shared framework for the underlying infrastructure. This substantially improves maintainability, consistency, reliability, and the ability to develop new signage applications without duplicating large amounts of code.


The environment also requires network\-level Python development, including socket\-based communication used to access the Vision system backend and associated APIs. This role may also involve integrating specialized hardware and device drivers into the Scala environment. * Work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to translate operational requirements into production solutions.
* Provide technical guidance for deployment, troubleshooting, support, and future expansion of the digital signage environment.

**Required Skills**

title: Software Engineer (Python/Wireless)
description:
Meet The Team
  
The Cisco Wireless Feature\& System Engineering team builds end\-to\-end wireless capabilities across access points, controllers, and cloud\-managed platforms. We design features that span device software, control planes, and management systems to deliver seamless, secure, and high\-performance enterprise Wi\-Fi.
  
  

Your Impact
  
A software engineer specializing in wireless technology at Cisco is responsible for driving the design, implementation, and optimization of wireless solutions for customer projects and accounts. This role requires a deep understanding of current and emerging wireless standards, including Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability), 802\.1X security types, and Layer 2 protocols. The engineer will leverage AI/ML knowledge to uplift test automation, develop new test plans, and build productivity\-enhancing tools, ensuring superior wireless network reliability, latency, performance, and customer outcomes.
  
  

**In this role:**  

* Lead technology design, planning, and deployment of wireless solutions, including small to mid\-size or moderately complex systems, ensuring reliability, availability, latency, resilience, and performance targets are met across current\-generation and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 environments.
* Collaborate with customers to plan, design, configure, and validate Cisco wireless technologies, including Wi\-Fi standards through Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn), Layer 2 protocols, WLAN technologies, and 802\.1X security types.
* Write new test automation scripts and uplift existing test scripts using Python to enhance wireless technology testing frameworks and improve automation efficiency.
* Utilize AI/ML techniques to uplift test automation frameworks, develop new test plans tailored to wireless and Wi\-Fi 8 reliability requirements, and build tools that improve productivity and streamline testing and deployment processes.
* Assist with integration and implementation of tools, systems, and service assurance related to wireless networks, including continuous monitoring, telemetry analysis, and alerting in test and production environments for latency, packet loss, roaming, interference, and reliability conditions.
* Support presales by translating business requirements into technical wireless solution designs and creating customer collateral, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Drive customer technology transitions and influence solution architectures and services in wireless networking, including readiness planning for Wi\-Fi 8 and Ultra High Reliability capabilities.
* Comply with company policies and utilize relevant tools to support Professional Services strategies and goals.
* Act as an individual contributor and mentor within the team, providing guidance and support to peers and engineering interns.
* Lead corrective actions, including root cause analysis and process improvements on escaped defects for specific product features.
* Implement automation frameworks and execute test cases and plans for projects with multiple features, including Wi\-Fi 8 functional, interoperability, performance, reliability, and regression validation.
* Report issues and findings with root cause analysis and potential software solutions; advocate for quality improvements and strategic changes.
* Oversee creation and storage of test plans and documentation; translate dashboard metrics into consumable documentation such as release notes, bug reports, and test results.
* Collaborate with other engineering groups to document test cases and apply best practices for document review.
* Develop productive working relationships with peer stakeholders within and across teams.
* Work independently with guidance from leadership to determine the best approach to accomplish work and act as a resource for less experienced colleagues.


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Deep domain\-based engineering and configuration knowledge of Cisco wireless technologies, with knowledge of current Wi\-Fi generations and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn) concepts.
* Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi standards, including Ultra High Reliability objectives, deterministic and tail\-latency behavior, packet\-loss reduction, roaming continuity, overlapping\-BSS performance, multi\-AP coordination concepts, coexistence, and backward compatibility.
* Strong expertise in AI/ML applications for test automation and productivity improvements.
* Experience in writing comprehensive test plans and building automation tools for wireless functional, interoperability, roaming, latency, packet\-loss, reliability, and performance validation.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills specific to wireless networks, including interference, congestion, roaming, latency, packet loss, and multi\-AP deployment scenarios.
* Excellent communication and customer engagement abilities.
* Experience in solution design activities.
* Ability to create and deliver technical documentation and training materials.


**Key technologies:**  

* Wi\-Fi Standards: Knowledge of Wi\-Fi generations, including Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Wi\-Fi 7, and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability). Understanding the evolution of these standards and their security, reliability, latency, power\-efficiency, coexistence, and performance objectives is essential.
* Wi\-Fi 8 / IEEE 802\.11bn: Familiarity with the emerging Ultra High Reliability amendment and its focus on WLAN reliability, latency, throughput, roaming continuity, power efficiency, peer\-to\-peer operation, coexistence, and overlapping\-BSS performance.
* Layer 2 Protocols: Familiarity with Layer 2 security policies such as WLAN, Static WEP, WPA/WPA2, WPA3, and especially 802\.1X authentication. Knowledge of encryption types like TKIP, AES, CCMP, and GCMP is important.
* WLAN Technologies: Expertise in Cisco wireless solutions, including configuration of WLAN security, use of Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, and deployment of secure WLANs with features such as Fast Secure Roaming (802\.11r), AAA integration with RADIUS and Cisco ISE, multi\-AP architectures, and telemetry\-driven assurance. Familiarity with Wi\-Fi 8 goals for improved reliability, latency, roaming resilience, and operation across overlapping BSS environments is desirable.
* 802\.1X Security Types: Deep understanding of 802\.1X authentication mechanisms including EAP types such as PEAP, EAP\-TLS, LEAP, and EAP\-FAST. Knowledge of how 802\.1X integrates with AAA servers (e.g., Cisco ISE) for centralized policy management, and how it supports secure network access and segmentation.
* Python programming for developing and uplifting test automation scripts, enhancing wireless technology testing frameworks and productivity.
* AI/ML Knowledge: Proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to improve wireless performance and operational efficiency. The role includes uplifting test automation, generating wireless test plans, building productivity tools, and validating Wi\-Fi 8 reliability objectives.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. description:
**Company Description**  

Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.


Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.


Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

 **Job Description**  

Join SanDisk's Storage Validation Engineering team and help deliver high\-quality software solutions for validating next\-generation flash storage products.


In this role, you will develop AI\-assisted Python automation solutions, analyze product and protocol requirements, execute validation on storage devices, investigate complex failures, and contribute to release qualification. You will work closely with software, firmware, validation, and release teams across India, Israel, and the United States.


This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy Python development, AI\-assisted engineering, system\-level debugging, Linux and Windows environments, and working close to hardware.


Responsibilities

* Understand product requirements, technical designs, and storage protocol specifications.
* Create comprehensive validation strategies including functional, negative, integration, stress, recovery, and regression scenarios.
* Plan, design, develop, review, and maintain automated validation solutions using Python and AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Validate storage features, software enhancements, and bug fixes on physical storage devices.
* Execute sanity, functional, integration, performance, and regression test campaigns.
* Analyze logs, reproduce failures, and isolate issues across test frameworks, host software, firmware, operating systems, and device layers.
* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings.
* Verify fixes and provide evidence\-based quality sign\-off.
* Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites.
* Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams.
* Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities.

  

**Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python with hands\-on experience developing automated test solutions.
* Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks.
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments.
* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities.


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software.
* Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA.
* Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data\-driven testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows.
* Working knowledge of C or C\+\+.
* Exposure to large\-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development.
* Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity.


What We Look For

* Strong problem\-solving and debugging abilities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware.
* Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign\-off.
* Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability.
* Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and make data\-driven decisions.
* Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies.
* Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams.
* Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results

  

**Additional Information**  

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.


Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us atjobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

description:

This position offers strong technical ownership across Bootloader, communication, diagnostics, and AUTOSAR BSW layers, with direct influence on architecture decisions, Software Integration Strategy, quality, and customer success. 	+ 5\+ years of work experience in automotive BSW development.
	+ 3\+ years of work experience with AUTOSAR software architect and software integrator.

* Creation of the complete software and delivery to the project team as well as software release documentation.
* Specification and execution of software integration tests (SWE5\) including documentation
* Technical mentoring/problem solving \& support integration of Platform software.
* Debugging and analyzing integration problems. This position will require close collaboration with Software project manager, lead software engineers, software architect, software test engineer and other departments to complete software development engineering and release.
* Support the development/maintenance of and adhere to the common software architecture. Ensure documented traceability from requirements through test cases meeting Automotive SPICE development process requirements.
* Implement and shape CI/CD future, with elements that will enable totally new possibilities and ways of working.
* Performing AutoSAR System configuration (SWC compositions like Component instances, connectors), optimize AUTOSAR based SW architecture in multicore environment.
* Lead enhancement of the controls and module/component architectures alongside strategic roadmap with cutting\-edge technology advancements and innovative solutions
* Works closely with customers, Start centre, Experts, Technical Leads to gain understanding of Customer requirements, and define SW architecture and high\-level designs/solutions to meet those needs.

**What we are looking for**:

* Strong knowledge of AutoSAR tool chain and sound working experience in Makefile development and setting up software build environment based on a C/C\+\+ compiler, linker to generate various target\-based products files from make and linker utility scripts.

* Must have experienced with 32bit Infineon TC 3xx microcontroller

* Experience in configuration \& Change management tools such as Plastic SCM, BitBucket, Gitlab, JIRA, Design tools such as EA, Unit testing tools such as TPT/CANTATA/VectorCAST/RTRT, Serial Comm testing tool such as CANoe/CANalyzer/NeoVI Fire, Cross compilers and debuggers like Lauterbach, Tasking.

Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet\-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.

* Test and verify **SAI (Switch Abstraction Interface)** integration and ASIC driver behavior.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Electronics**, **Computer Science**, or a related field.
* 10 years of experience in **network software or hardware testing**.
* Strong understanding of **L2/L3 networking protocols** and **switch/router architecture**.
* Hands\-on experience with **SONiC NOS** and **SAI\-based architectures**.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with test automation frameworks such as **Robot Framework**.
* Solid grasp of SONiC architecture, including **SAI**, **FRR**, **Redis DB**, **Docker**, and **Minigraph**.

* Proficient with tools such as **Git**, **Jenkins**, **Docker**, and lab\-based testbed environments.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.

title: Senior Tech Lead - AUTOSAR
description:
- **Senior Tech Lead \- AUTOSAR**

Help shape the future of mobility.


Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high\-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error.


**Your Role**


	* Design, develop, and maintain embedded software solutions for automotive applications, leveraging expertise in embedded systems and real\-time operating systems (RTOS)
	* Implement automotive communication protocols and integrate software modules with microcontroller architectures to ensure seamless operation within vehicle systems
	* Integrate embedded software development activities into the automotive product development process, following established procedures and standards such as AUTOSAR and ASPICE
	* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements, develop software architectures, and deliver high\-quality embedded software solutions in alignment with project objectives
	* Lead testing and debugging efforts for embedded software components, utilizing tools like Vector CANalyzer and CANoe to analyze communication protocols and verify system behavior
	* Manage embedded software requirements using tools like DOORS, ensuring traceability and alignment with project goals and customer needs
	* Document software design specifications, test plans, and validation reports to support the development and verification of embedded software solutions
	* Utilize version control systems such as Git and collaboration platforms like JIRA and Gerrit to manage software repositories and facilitate team collaboration
	* Ensure compliance with automotive product development processes and standards such as ASPICE, adhering to established guidelines and procedures throughout the software development lifecycle
	* Conduct code reviews, perform static analysis, and contribute to quality assurance activities to validate the integrity and safety of embedded software implementations**Your Background**

**Key ingredients for succeeding in this role are your:**


	* B.E. / B. Tech / M.E. / M. Tech in any specialization with an experience of 8\-15 years
	* Proficient in C and Microcontroller(S32, Aurix, Renesas), Experience working on Embedded/Autosar SW development
	* Analyze, interpret and clarify customer Autosar requirements
	* Deep expertise in more than two AUTOSAR BSW stack/MCAL modules\- com stack(CAN, Ethernet),Memory Stack, Diagnostic Stack, Cybersecurity Stack ,OS, Watchdog ,MCAL
	* Experience in CDD \& RTE, Experience on Vector/Mentor Autosar Tools
	* Experience on Autosar Multicore architecture. Understanding of 16/32\-bit microcontrollers
	* Experience with min one microcontroller architectures: Renesas RH family or TRICOR or PowerPC architecture
	* Expertise with development tolls: CANalyzer, debugger, oscilloscopes
	* Understanding and working experience on ASPICE and AGILE methodologies.
	* Functional Safety, Cyber Security**Why join us?**


	* You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
	* You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
	* You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.**Your Benefits at Aptiv:**


	* Flexible working hours;
	* Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development);
	* Life and accident insurance;
	* Sodexo cards for food and beverages;
	* Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;
	* EAP Employee Assistance;
	* Access to fitness clubs (T\&C apply);
	* Creche facility for working parents;Apply today, and together let’s change tomorrow!
