title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility \& high\-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi\-tiered, low\-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning\-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non\-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.  

  

The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop full\-stack solutions for Post Add to Cart and Cart services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi\-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data\-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

  

A day in the life  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full\-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning\-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long\-term health.  

  

About the team  

We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Engineer/Platform Engineer - Kubernetes + Golang/Python + AI (5+ Years)
description:
Meet the Team
  
  

You will be pivotal in contributing to the team responsible for designing and developing the next generation of scalable Kubernetes infrastructure with Foundational Model and GPU Platforms. This is a position for experienced engineers where you will lead the technical direction, ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of AI systems while collaborating closely with data scientists, researchers, and other engineering teams.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

You will architect scalable infrastructure, and implement standard methodologies for Infrastructure as a Code with Golang along with developing platforms which offers LLMs and GPUs as service. Your leadership will influence the adoption of modern technologies and processes while mentoring junior engineers to strengthen the team’s technical foundation. This role is perfect for someone with a deep passion for solving engineering challenges in the fast\-paced AI/ML space, with a focus on delivering high\-impact solutions at scale.
  
  

Core Responsibilities
  
  

**As a Platform Engineer with AI/ML Experience you will:**  

* Design and develop scalable Kubernetes\-based platform components, focusing on reliability, multi\-tenancy, and efficient workload orchestration.
* Build and enhance platform capabilities to support Kubernetes workloads and emerging GenAI workloads (including GPU\-based deployments), ensuring performance and cost efficiency.
* Develop backend services and platform tooling using Golang and/or Python, following strong software engineering practices.
* Contribute to AIOps initiative across platforms by collaborating with multi\-functional teams, including SREs, Software Engineers to operationalize and optimize AI workflows effectively.
* Implement and improve observability frameworks (metrics, logs, traces) to enhance platform visibility and debugging.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to improve platform consistency and operational efficiency.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability, and performance through meticulous engineering practices with operational rigor.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, contributing to round the clock support, incident response, troubleshooting, and continuous reliability improvements.
* Conduct code reviews, establish standard processes, and mentor junior engineers.
* Stay updated on the latest trends in AI/ML to influence platform enhancements.


Minimum Qualifications / Requirements
  
  

* Experience: 5\-7 years of software engineering experience
* Expertise in Golang or Python, with hands\-on experience with Kubernetes platform Along with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Assist in the design, implementation, and day\-to\-day operation of a Kubernetes platform supporting microservices architecture.
* Support and help improve the existing platform that hosts a large number of business applications.
* Help automate legacy platforms to enable infrastructure as code, increasing efficiency and consistency in platform management.
* Consistent track record in designing and deploying scalable machine learning systems in production.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows, including model monitoring and retraining.
* Proficiency in cloud platforms and orchestration tools for distributed systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills for complex, large\-scale systems.
* Experience in mentoring engineers and driving technical decision\-making.


Preferred Qualifications / Requirements
  
  

* Sophisticated understanding in Kubernetes for managing production\-grade systems and ensuring scalability.
* Sophisticated experience with Docker and orchestration of complex services.
* Expertise in Golang or Python
* Develop\& enforce secure software development lifecycle
* Experience with architecting and optimizing workflows using Kubeflow pipelines, KServe, Airflow, and MLflow.
* Ability to design and implement efficient CI/CD workflows for LLM/GPU provisioning.
* Understanding of LangChain and experience designing RAG systems.
* Knowledge of integrating and scaling vector databases for real\-world applications.
* Consistent record of designing and leading the development of distributed systems.
* Experience with implementing robust inter\-service communication patterns and solving scalability issues.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**


Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Are you looking for your next big challenge?**


For more than 90 years, Caterpillar Inc. has been making sustainable progress possible and driving positive change on every continent. Customers turn to Caterpillar to help them develop infrastructure, energy and natural resource assets. With 2019 sales and revenues of $53\.8 billion, Caterpillar is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel\-electric locomotives.


Caterpillar is investing in our digital future, and we’re looking for the best Software Engineer. Our iconic products have evolved from mechanical work horses to highly sophisticated, electronically\-controlled worksite solutions. This transformation, along with our smart factories and our integrated dealer network, has a wealth of data ready to be leveraged by our customers and our dealers. Think you have what it takes to develop the software and architect the platform to support Caterpillar’s digital revolution? We at Caterpillar Digital are working to put together the Digital platform for delivering industry\-leading digital solutions in support of profitable growth for Caterpillar, dealers \& our end customers.


Come join us in this exciting journey and be part of the world class organization and play a key role in its digital transformation.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Lead – Java, AWS, Microservices \& AI Engineering**


We are seeking a highly skilled **Technical Lead** to lead the design, development, and delivery of cloud\-native enterprise applications and platform services. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in **Java, Spring Boot, AWS, Microservices, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL**, along with proven experience leading engineering teams, driving architecture decisions, and delivering scalable, resilient solutions. This role aligns closely with internal platform engineering leadership expectations for Java, AWS, and microservices\-based systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead solution architecture, technical design, and implementation of enterprise\-scale applications and platform services.
* Design and develop cloud\-native microservices and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Drive AWS\-based application development utilizing modern cloud and DevOps practices.
* Establish engineering standards, code quality, observability, performance, and security best practices.
* Mentor engineers, conduct design reviews, and provide technical leadership across teams.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Champion AI\-driven innovation by identifying and implementing Generative AI, AI\-assisted development, and intelligent automation opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated technical leadership.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in:


	+ Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud
	+ Microservices and Distributed Systems
	+ REST API Design and Development
	+ AWS Cloud Services
	+ PostgreSQL Database Design and Optimization
	+ Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience building scalable, secure, and highly available cloud\-native applications.

**AI \& Modern Engineering Expectations**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications and business workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven engineering tools and practices that improve developer productivity and software delivery outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* AWS or AI\-related certifications.
* Experience leading modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

**Success in this role** will be demonstrated through delivery of scalable business solutions, strong technical leadership, adoption of modern engineering practices, and effective application of AI technologies to create measurable business and engineering value.

September 16, 2026 \- September 24, 2026

title: Senior Storage Software Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


**Senior Storage Software Engineer**
====================================


**About the Role**
------------------


* We are looking for an experienced Storage Software Engineer with 12\-15 years of software engineering experience to design, architect, and build highly scalable Block, File, and Object Storage platforms in Kubernetes environments.
* This is a deeply hands\-on engineering role that combines systems programming, distributed systems, storage architecture, and cloud\-native technologies. You will be responsible for building production\-grade storage software with a strong focus on performance, scalability, reliability, availability, and data durability.
* The ideal candidate can take complex storage challenges end\-to\-end—from architecture and design to coding, testing, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and production deployment—while collaborating with other engineers to continuously evolve and strengthen the storage platform.

### **Responsibilities**


* Design and develop distributed Block, File, and Object Storage systems.
* Architect highly available, scalable, fault\-tolerant, and high\-performance storage platforms.

JLL REMS (Real Estate Management Services) is building next\-generation AI\-powered solutions to transform how our clients interact with and derive insights from property management data. We are seeking a talented Full Stack AI Engineer who combines deep AI expertise with full\-stack development capabilities to join our team.
  
As a Full Stack AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy end\-to\-end GenAI solutions that enable users to retrieve knowledge, analyze information through intuitive interfaces. You will be responsible for building intelligent backend systems that translate natural language into actionable queries, as well as creating user\-facing interfaces that deliver AI\-powered insights, filtered dashboards, and summaries in multiple languages.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**AI development:**  

Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art GenAI\-based solutions for property management applications.
  
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LLMs to efficiently utilize property management data from data warehouses and semantic indexes.
  
Implement AI based techniques to extract valuable insights and patterns from data, enabling actionable recommendations and predictions.
  
Design and develop agentic AI systems and implement Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for enhanced AI capabilities.
  
Develop and fine\-tune GenAI wirkflows for complex decision\-making scenarios.
  
  

**Full Stack Development:**  

Develop and implement robust web applications using React, Python, Django, and the Django REST Framework.
  
Design and develop efficient, scalable backend applications and APIs that integrate seamlessly with AI models.
  
Create responsive and intuitive front\-end interfaces using React / NextJS, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  
Implement secure coding practices and adhere to industry best practices across the full stack.
  
  

**Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps:**  

Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for scalable cloud deployments.
  
Deploy and manage AI services on cloud platforms, including Azure Search Service and OpenSearch.
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other automation tools.
  
Ensure scalability, performance, and reliability through regular testing, debugging, and optimization.
  
Implement containerization using Docker and orchestration for microservices architectures.
  
  

**Collaboration \& Delivery:**  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including BI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements and define project scope.
  
Translate business requirements into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  
Provide technical guidance and support to teams in integrating and utilizing AI\-powered solutions effectively.
  
Conduct code reviews and address bugs, performance issues, and technical debt.
  
Work effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment to ensure timely and successful delivery.
  
  

**Continuous Innovation:**  

Keep up to date with the latest advancements in GenAI technologies, LLMs, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Continuously improve software development processes and practices.
  
Stay current with emerging cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and full\-stack development trends.
  
  

**To apply you need to be:**  

Experience \& Education
  
  

**Required:**  

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field.
  
3\+ years of proven experience as an AI Engineer, Full Stack Developer, or similar role.
  
Strong proficiency in Python and relevant AI libraries and frameworks (LangChain, Langgraph etc.).
  
Demonstrated experience developing GenAI\-based solutions and tools using LLMs.
  
In\-depth knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, including language models, RAG pipelines, and text generation algorithms.
  
Strong proficiency in full\-stack development with React / NextJS, Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
  
**Experience with front\-end technologies:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern React patterns.
  
Strong knowledge of SQL and database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  
Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  
Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  
Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS or Azure) and their AI services.
  
Familiarity with Azure Search Service and/or OpenSearch for semantic search implementations.
  
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and distributed computing architectures.
  
Experience working with large\-scale datasets and implementing data processing pipelines.
  
Strong understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and best practices.
  
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycle.
  
  

**Preferred:**  

Experience developing agentic AI systems and implementing Model Context Protocols (MCPs).
  
Familiarity with vector databases and semantic indexing technologies.
  
Experience with API gateway design and microservices architectures.
  
Knowledge of security best practices for AI systems and data privacy compliance.
  
Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization tools like DataDog.
  
Skills \& Competencies
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and innovative environment.
  
Excellent problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  
Self\-starter with the ability to quickly learn, adapt, and conduct POCs as the GenAI landscape evolves.
  
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for non\-technical stakeholders.
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
  
Passion for learning and staying updated with rapidly evolving AI technologies and industry trends.
  
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  
  

**What's in it for you:**  

The opportunity to work at a rapid\-growth company and industry leader in commercial real estate services.
  
Flexible, high\-energy work environment and culture that encourages innovation.
  
Work on cutting\-edge GenAI technologies and shape the future of property management solutions.
  
Collaborative team environment with opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  
Exposure to the latest advancements in AI, cloud infrastructure, and full\-stack development.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
**Data \& Integrations Team \| Navan**



Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the **Enterprise Team**, you will be a technical leader building the backbone of our corporate travel infrastructure. You will architect and develop the critical systems that allow the world's largest companies to configure, manage, and scale their travel programs—covering everything from complex policy engines and approval workflows to user lifecycle management and enterprise analytics.



This is a high\-impact engineering role where you will solve complex logic and scalability challenges. You will ensure that our platform can handle sophisticated corporate rules and seamless integrations for massive global organizations. You'll collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and architects to design and build innovative solutions that empower our customers to manage their travel spend effectively.


**What You'll Do**


* **Architect Enterprise Core Services:** Design, build, and evolve the backend microservices that power the "brain" of the corporate travel platform—specifically the engines responsible for travel policies, dynamic approval workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* **Build Data\-Driven Services:** Design and develop highly scalable APIs and data processing services that manage high volumes of data, power reporting features, and enable seamless integrations with both internal and external systems.
* **Own Systems End\-to\-End:** Take technical ownership of a problem domain, architecting, developing, and launching key backend features and microservices that have a direct impact on our users and business operations.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work cross\-functionally with various engineering, product, and business teams to deliver complex, cross\-domain features in a collaborative, global environment.
* **Drive the Technical Vision:** Partner with engineering and product leadership to define and execute the long\-term technical roadmap for our data platform. Be a subject matter expert on backend architecture, distributed systems, and data integration patterns.
* **Champion Best Practices:** Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high\-quality, scalable, and well\-tested code. Mentor other engineers on backend development and advocate for best practices in system design, API development, monitoring, and operational reliability.


**What We're Looking For**


* 4\+ years of experience in backend software development, building large\-scale distributed systems for SaaS products or consumer\-facing applications in a fast\-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in backend development using **Java and Spring Boot**, with a strong grasp of JVM fundamentals, performance tuning, and concurrency.
* Proven experience with databases (**SQL and/or NoSQL**), complex data modeling, and query optimization to handle large datasets.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, resilient applications using **microservices, distributed systems, and event\-driven architectures** on cloud platforms (**AWS** preferred).
* Demonstrates strong technical ownership and a collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a proven ability to ship production\-quality services equipped with robust testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* A passion for investigating and solving challenging problems in system scalability and data integrity, with a willingness to learn and utilize new tools and technologies.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands\-on experience.


**Bonus Points For**


* Experience with AI/ML technologies, particularly in building backend systems to support agentic AI, LLM\-based features, or autonomous workflows.
* Deep familiarity with data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis), ETL processes, and reporting systems.
* Experience with performance and scalability testing for high\-throughput services.
* Familiarity with travel industry concepts (e.g., bookings, inventory, integrations with GDS or other suppliers).

title: Software Engineer

The Cisco Intersight team is at the forefront of Cisco’s AI Infrastructure strategy, serving as the intelligent management platform that orchestrates and simplifies complex hybrid cloud environments. A successful candidate will have deep technical and software expertise in cloud\-native technologies and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, startup\-like environment to deliver seamless, scalable solutions with broad business impact.
  
  

We seek individuals driven by the challenge of solving unique technical problems, who thrive with creative freedom, and are eager to explore new territories and learn. You care about your work and its impact.
  
  

You will develop and validate infrastructure, software components, and integrations in on\-prem and cloud environments. You should have a good sense of product design, passion for quality and customers, and willingness to work in small, self\-organizing teams are essential. If you want to excel in a fast\-paced environment creating and shaping the future of AI infrastructure, this job is for you!
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's in Computer Science (or equivalent) with 5 years or Master's with 3 years or PhD with 0 year of related experience.
* Experience programming with Go, C/C\+\+, Java and/or Python
* Experience with microservices software architecture and large\-scale distributed systems
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, and software design
* Experience working with cloud technologies like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud

* Hands\-on experience withcontainerizationand orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
